tataḥ pradehāḥ pariṣecanāni nasyāni dhūmāśca
                            yathāsvameva/
akṣṇoḥ samantataḥ kāryaṃ pātanaṃ ca jalaukasām//

ghṛtasya mahatī mātrā pītā cārtiṃ
                            niyacchati/

trapu kāṃsyamalaṃ cāpi piṣṭvā puṣparasena
                            tu/
vipulā yāḥ kṛtā vartyaḥ pūjitāścāñjane sadā//

yuktaṃ tu madhunā vā+api gairikaṃ
                            hitamañjane/

madhunā tārkṣyajaṃ vā+api kāsīaṃ vā
                            sasaidhavam/
ekaśo vā dviśo vā+api yojitaṃ vā tribhistribhiḥ//

sphaṭikaṃ vidrumaṃ śaṅkho madhukaṃ kadhu caiva
                            hi/
dvitvaggate saśūle vā vātaghnaṃ tarpaṇaṃ hitam//
ajakāṃ pārśvato viddhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam//

jātyāḥ puṣpaṃ saindhavaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ kṛṣṇābījaṃ
                            kīṭaśatrośca sāram/

pūyālase śoṇitamokṣaṇaṃ ca hitaṃ
                            tathaivāpyupanāhanaṃ ca/

patraṃ phalaṃ cāmalakasya paktvā kriyāṃ
                            vidadhyādathavā+añjanārthe/
vaṃśasya bhūlena rasakriyāṃ vā vartīkṛtāṃ tāmrakapālapakvām//
piṣṭvā chagalyāḥ payasā malaṃ vā kāṃsasya dagdhvā saha tāntavena//
samudraphenaṃ lavaṇottamaṃ ca śaṅkho+atha mudgo maricaṃ ca śuklam//
praklinnavartmanyapi caita eva yogāḥ prayojyāśca samīkṣya doṣam//

sakajjalaṃ tāmraghaṭe ca ghṛṣṭaṃ sarpiryutaṃ
                            tulthakamañjanaṃ ca//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre
                        raktābhiṣyandapratiṣedho nāma dvādaśo+adhyāyaḥ //12//

plotāntarābhyāṃ na
                            yathā calati sraṃsate+api vā//
likhecchastreṇa patrairvā tato rakte sthite punaḥ//
vartmāvabandhaṃ kliṣṭaṃ ca bahalaṃ yacca kīrtitam//

bhaveyurvartmasu ca yāḥ piḍakāḥ kaṭhinā
                            bhṛśam/

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre
                        lekhyarogapratiṣedho nāma trayodaśo+adhyāyaḥ //13//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre
                        bhedyarogapratiṣedho nāma caturdaśo+adhyāyaḥ //14//
vraṇavat saṃvidhānaṃ tu tasya kuryādataḥ param//

arma cālpaṃ dadhinibhaṃ nīlaṃ raktamathāpi
                            vā/
chedyameva tadarma syāt kṛṣṇamaṇḍalagaṃ ca yat//

sirāsu piḍakā jātā yā na sidhyanti
                            bheṣajaiḥ/
śaṅkhaṃ samudraphenaṃ ca maṇḍūkīṃ ca samudrajām//
armāṇi piḍakāṃ hanyāt sirājālāni tena vai//
sthite ca rudhire vartma dahet samyak śalākayā//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre
                        chedyarogapratiṣedho nāma pñcadaśo+adhyāyaḥ //15//

yāpyastu yo vartmabhavo vikāraḥ
                            pakṣmaprakopo+abhihitaḥ purastāt/
sthairyaṃ gate cāpyatha śastramārge bālān vimuñcet kuśalo+abhivīkṣya//

evaṃ na cecchāmyati tasya vartma nirbhujya
                            doṣopahatāṃ valiṃ ca/
tato+agninā vā pratisārayettāṃ kṣāreṇa vā samyagavekṣya dhīraḥ//
pathyāphalena pratisārayettu ghṛṣṭena vā tauvarakeṇa samyak//

catvāra ete vidhayo vihantuṃ pakṣmoparodhaṃ
                            pṛthageva śastāḥ/

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre
                        pakṣmagatarogapratiṣedho nāma ṣoḍaśo+adhyāyaḥ //16//

trayaḥ sādhyāstrayo+asādhyā yāpyāḥ ṣaṭ ca
                            bhavanti hi/

tailvakaṃ cobhayoḥ pathyaṃ kevalaṃ jīrṇameva
                            vā/
gairikaṃ saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇā godantasya maṣī tathā//
medo yakṛdghṛtaṃ cājaṃ pippalyaḥ saidhavaṃ madhu//

nadījaśimbītrikaṭūnyathāñjanaṃ manaḥśilā dve ca
                            niśe yakṛd(śakṛd)gavām/

bhavanti yāpyāḥ khalu ye ṣaḍāmayā haredasṛkteṣu
                            sirāvimokṣaṇaiḥ/

payovimiśraṃ pavanodbhave hitaṃ vadanti
                            pañcāṅgulatailameva tu/

trivṛdvirekaḥ kaphaje praśasyate tridoṣaje
                            tailamuśanti tatkṛtam/

hitaṃ ca vidyāttriphalāghṛtaṃ sadā kṛtaṃ ca
                            yanmeṣaviṣāṇanāmabhiḥ/

samīraje tailayutāṃ kaphātmake madhupragāḍhāṃ
                            vidadhīta yuktitaḥ/
gavāṃ śakṛtkvāthavipakvamuttamaṃ hitaṃ tu tailaṃ timireṣu nāvanam//

hitaṃ ghṛtaṃ kevala eva paittike hyajāvikaṃ
                            yanmadhurairvipācitam/
tailaṃ sthirādau madhure ca yadgaṇe tathā+aṇutailaṃ pavanāsṛgutthayoḥ//

sahāśvagandhātibalāvarīśṛtaṃ hitaṃ ca nasye
                            trivṛtaṃ yadīritam/
subhāvitaṃ vā payasā dinatrayaṃ kācāpahaṃ śāstravidaḥ pracakṣate//

havirhitaṃ kṣīrabhavaṃ tu paittike vadanti
                            nasye madhurauṣadhaiḥ kṛtam/
tattarpaṇe caiva hitaṃ prayojitaṃ sajāṅgalasteṣu ca yaḥ puṭāhvayaḥ//
samāñjanaṃ vā kanakākarodbhavaṃ sucūrṇitaṃ śreṣṭhamuśanti tadvidaḥ//

bhilloṭagandhodakasekasecitaṃ pratyañjane cātra
                            hitaṃ tu tutthakam/
vanaspatikvāthavipācitaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitaṃ haridrānalade ca tarpaṇam//

samāgadho mākṣikasaindhavāḍhyaḥ sajāṅgalaḥ syāt
                            puṭapāka eva ca/

hite ca kāsīsarasāñjane tathā vadanti pathye
                            guḍanāgarairyute/
yadañjanaṃ vā bahuśo niṣecitaṃ samūtravarge triphalodake śṛte//
meṣasya puṣpairmadhukena saṃyutaṃ tadañjanaṃ sarvakṛte prayojayet//

kriyāśca sarvāḥ kṣatajodbhave hitaḥ kramaḥ
                            parimlāyini cāpi pittahṛt/
kramo hitaḥ syandaharaḥ prayojitaḥ samīkṣya doṣeṣu

doṣodaye naiva ca viplutiṃgate dravyāṇi
                            nasyādiṣu yojayedbudhaḥ/

ghṛtaṃ purāṇaṃ triphalāṃ śatāvarīṃ
                            paṭolamudgāmalakaṃ yavānapi/
niṣevamāṇasya narasya yatnato bhayaṃ sughorarāttimirānna vidyate//

śatāvarīpāyasa eva kevalastathā kṛto
                            vā++āmalakeṣu pāyasaḥ/

jīvantiśākaṃ suniṣaṇṇakaṃ ca sataṇḍulīyaṃ
                            varavāstukaṃ ca/
cillī tathā mūlakapotikā ca dṛṣṭerhitaṃ śākunajāṅgalaṃ ca//

ślaiṣmike liṅganāśe tu karma vakṣyāmi
                            siddhaye/

viṣamo vā tanurmadhye rājimān vā
                            bahuprabhaḥ/
dṛṣṭistho lakṣyate doṣaḥ sarujo vā salohitaḥ//

nādho nordhvaṃ na pārśvābhyāṃ chidre daivakṛte
                            tataḥ/
dakṣiṇena bhiṣak savyaṃ vidhyet savyena cetarat//

sthire doṣe cale vā+api svedayedakṣi
                            bāhyataḥ/

tadā+asau likhitā samyag jñeyā yā cāpi
                            nirvyathā/
tato gṛhe nirābādhe śayītottāna eva ca//
paścātkarma ca seveta laghvannaṃ cāpi mātrayā//

sirāvyadhavidhau pūrvaṃ narā ye ṛca
                            vivarjitāḥ/

athāpyupari viddhe tu kaṣṭā ruk
                            saṃpravartate/
rujāyāmakṣirāge vā yogān bhūyo nibodha me/
gairikaṃ sārivā dūrvā yavapiṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ//
tataḥ sirāṃ dahedvā+api matimān kīrtitaṃ yathā//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre
                        dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyo nāma saptadaśo+adhyāyaḥ //17//
tatra tatropadiṣṭāni teṣāṃ vyāsaṃ nibodha me//
svasthe kaphe ṣaṭ pitte+aṣṭau daśa vāte taduttamam//

ekāhaṃ vā tryahaṃ vā+api pañcāhaṃ ceṣyate
                            param/

tarpaṇārhā na ye proktāḥ snehapānākṣamāśca
                            ye/
snehataḥ puṭapākastu dhāryo dve vākśate tu saḥ//

vitarettarpaṇoktaṃ tu dhūmaṃ hitvā tu
                            ropaṇam/
snehasvedau dvayoḥ kāryau kāryo naiva ca ropaṇe//

ekāhaṃ vā dvyahaṃ vā+api tryahaṃ
                            vā+apyavacāraṇam/
dvau bilvamātrau ślakṣṇasya piṇḍau māṃsasya peṣitau//

dravyāṇāṃ bilvamātraṃ tu dravāṇāṃ kuḍavo
                            mataḥ/
rakte pitte ca tau śītau koṣṇau vātakaphāpahau//
lekhane sapta cāṣṭau vā bindavaḥ snaihike daśa//
sekasya dviguṇaḥ kālaḥ puṭapākāt paro mataḥ//

tarpaṇoktaṃ daśaguṇaṃ yathādoṣaṃ vidhānavit//
                            vyaktarūpeṣu doṣeṣu śuddhakāyasya kevale//

kaṣāyaṃ tiktakaṃ vā+api sasnehaṃ ropaṇaṃ
                            matam/
audumbaryaśmajā vā+api śārīrī vā hitā bhavet//

doṣaḥ pratinivṛttaḥ san hanyād dṛṣṭerbalaṃ
                            tathā/
tatra doṣaharaṃ rūkṣaṃ bheṣajaṃ śasyate mṛdu//
gavāṃ śakṛdrase mūtre dadhni sarpiṣi mākṣike//
niṣecayet pṛthak cainaṃ dhmātaṃ dhmātaṃ punaḥ punaḥ//
śātakumbhe+atha śārṅge vā rājate vā susaṃskṛte/
meṣaśṛṅgasya puṣpāṇi vakraṃ ratnāpi sapta ca//

vakraṃ samaricaṃ caiva māṃsīṃ śaileyameva
                            ca/

abhyāhate tu nayane bahudhā narāṇāṃ
                            saṃrambharāgatumulāsu rujāsu dhīmān/

dṛṣṭiprasādajananaṃ vidhimāśu kuryāt
                            snigdhairhimaiśca madhuraiśca tathā prayogai/

sadyohate nayana eṣa vidhistadūrdhvaṃ syanderito
                            bhavati doṣamavekṣya kāryaḥ/

sādhyaṃ kṣataṃ paṭalamekamubhe tu kṛcchre trīṇi
                            kṣatāni paṭalāni vivarjayattu/

syāt piccitaṃ ca nayanaṃ hyati cāvasannaṃ srastaṃ cyutaṃ ca hatadṛk ca
                            bhavettu yāpyam//

netre vilambini vidhirvihitaḥ
                            purastāducchiṅghanaṃ śirasi vāryavasecanaṃ ca/

ṣaṭsaptatirnayanajā ya ime pradiṣṭā rogā bhavantyamahatāṃ mahatāṃ ca
                            tebhyaḥ//
mṛdnāti netramatikaṇḍumathākṣikūṭaṃ nāsālalāṭamapi tena śiśuḥ sa nityam//

sūryaprabhāṃ na sahate sravati prabaddhaṃ
                            tasyāharedrudhiramāśu vinirlikhecca/

kṣaudrāyutaiśca kaṭubhiḥ pratisārayettu mātuḥ śiśorabhihitaṃ ca vidhiṃ
                            vidadhyāt//

taṃ vāmayettu madhusaindhavasaṃprayuktaiḥ pītaṃ
                            payaḥ khalu phalaiḥ kharamañjarīṇām//

dattvā vacāmaśanadugdhabhuje prayojyamūrdhvaṃ tataḥ phalayutaṃ vamanaṃ
                            vidhijñaiḥ//

āścyotane ca hitamatra ghṛtaṃ guḍūcīsiddhaṃ tathā++āhurapi ca
                            triphalāvipakvam//

syādañjanaṃ madhurasāmadhukāmrakairvā kṛṣṇāyasaṃ ghṛtapayo madhu vā+api
                            dagdham//

vyoṣaṃ palāṇḍu madhukaṃ lavaṇottamaṃ ca lākṣāṃ
                            ca gairikayutāṃ guṭikāñjanaṃ vā/

syande kaphādabhihitaṃ kramamācarecca bālasya rogakuśalo+akṣigadaṃ
                            jighāṃsuḥ//

samudra iva gambhīraṃ naiva śakyaṃ
                            cikitsitam/

karṇaśūlaṃ praṇādaśca bādhiryaṃ kṣveḍa eva
                            ca/
karoti doṣaiśca yathāsvamāvṛtaḥ sa karṇaśūlaḥ kathito durācaraḥ//

yadā tu nāḍīṣu vimārgamāgataḥ sa eva
                            śabdābhivahāsu tiṣṭhati/
śrṇoti śabdān vividhāṃstadā naraḥ praṇādamenaṃ kathayanti cāmayam//

sa eva śabdānuvahā yadā sirāḥ kaphānuyāto
                            vyanusṛtya tiṣṭhati/
viriktaśīrṣasya ca śītasevinaḥ karoti hi kṣveḍamatīva karṇayoḥ//
sravettu pūyaṃ śravaṇo+anilāvṛtaḥ sa karṇasaṃsrāva iti prakīrtitaḥ//

kaphena kaṇḍūḥ pracitena karṇayorbhṛśaṃ bhavet
                            srotasi karṇasaṃjñite/
viśoṣite śleṣmaṇi pittatejasā nṛṇāṃ bhavet srotasi karṇagūthakaḥ//

sa karṇaviṭko dravatāṃ yadā gato vilāyito
                            ghrāṇamukhaṃ prapadyate/

yadā tu mūrcchantyathavā+api jantavaḥ
                            sṛjantyapatyānyathavā+api makṣikāḥ/

bhavet prapākaḥ khalu pittakopato
                            vikothavikledakaraśca karṇayoḥ/
sthite kaphe srotasi pittatejasaḥ vilāyyamāne bhṛśasaṃpratāpavān//

avedano vā+apyathavā savedano ghanaṃ sravet
                            pūti ca pūtikarṇakaḥ/
mayā purastāt prasamīkṣya yojayedihaiva tāvat prayato bhiṣagvaraḥ//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre
                        karṇagatarogavijñānīyo nāma viṃśatitamo+adhyāyaḥ //20//
tat prāptaṃ śravaṇasrotaḥ sadyo gṛhṇāti vedanām//

niranno niśi tatsarpiḥ pītvopari pibet
                            payaḥ/

kuryādevaṃ bhadrakāṣṭhe kuṣṭhe kāṣṭhe ca
                            sārale/

mūtreṣvamleṣu vātaghne gaṇe ca kvathite
                            bhiṣak/

etā eva kriyāḥ kuryāt pittaghnaiḥ
                            pittasaṃyute/
kākolyādau daśakṣīraṃ tiktaṃ cātra hitaṃ haviḥ//

ekaikaḥ pūraṇe pathyastailaṃ teṣvapi vā
                            kṛtam/
gavāṃ mūtreṇa bilvāni piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipācayet//

sajalaṃ ca sadugdhaṃ ca bādhirye
                            karṇapūraṇam/
vakṣyate yaḥ pratiśyāye vidhiḥ so+apyatra pūjitaḥ//

vātavyādhiṣu yaścokto vidhiḥ sa ca hito
                            bhavet/
chardanaṃ dhūmapānaṃ ca kavalasya ca dhāraṇam//

karṇakṣveḍe hitaṃ tailaṃ sārṣapaṃ caiva
                            pūraṇam/

ānahyate yasya vidhūpyate ca praklidyate
                                śuṣyati
na vetti yo gandharasāṃśca janturjuṣṭaṃ vyavasyettamapīnasena//

nireti pūtirmukhanāsikābhyāṃ taṃ pūtināsaṃ
                            pravadanti rogam/
vrāṇāśritaṃ pittamarūṃṣi kuryādyasmin vikāre balavāṃśca pākaḥ//
caturvidhaṃ dviprabhavaṃ vakṣyāmi bhūyaḥ khalu raktapittam//
nāsā sravet pūyamasṛgvimiśraṃ taṃ pūyaraktaṃ pravadanti rogam//

kaphānuyāto bahuśaḥ saśabdastaṃ rogamāhuḥ
                            kṣavathuṃ vidhijñāḥ/

prāk saṃcito mūrdhani pittataptastaṃ
                            bhraṃśathuṃ vyādhimudāharanti/
ghrāṇe bhṛśaṃ dāhasamanvite tu viniḥsareddhūma iveha vāyuḥ//

nāsā pradīpteva ca yasya jantorvyādhiṃ tu taṃ
                            dīptamudāharanti/
kaphāvṛto vāyurudānasaṃjño yadā svamārge viguṇaḥ sthitaḥ syāt//

ghrāṇaṃ vṛṇotīva tadā sa rogo nāsāpratīnāha iti
                            pradiṣṭaḥ/

rātrau viśeṣeṇa hi taṃ vikāraṃ
                            nāsāparisrāvamiti vyavasyet/
ghrāṇāśrite śleṣmaṇi mārutena pittena gāḍhaṃ pariśoṣite ca//
rogaḥ pratiśyāya ihopadiṣṭaḥ sa vakṣyate pañcavidhaḥ purastāt//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre
                        nāsāgatarogavijñānīyo nāma dvāviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ //22//

pūrvoddiṣṭe pūtinasye ca jantoḥ snehasvedau
                            chardanaṃ sraṃsanaṃ ca/
yuktaṃ bhaktaṃ tīkṣṇamalpaṃ laghu syāduṣṇaṃ toyaṃ dhūmapānaṃ ca kāle//

hiṅgu vyoṣaṃ vatsakākhyaṃ śivāṭī lākṣā bījaṃ
                            saurabhaṃ kaṭphalaṃ ca/
ugrā kuṣṭhaṃ tīkṣṇagandhā viḍaṅgaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nityaṃ cāvapīḍe karañjam//

etairdravyaiḥ sārṣapaṃ mūtrayuktaṃ tailaṃ
                            dhīmānnasyahetoḥ paceta/
nāsāpāke pittahṛtsaṃvidhānaṃ kāryaṃ sarvaṃ bāhyamābhyantaraṃ ca//

hṛtvā raktaṃ kṣīravṛkṣatvacaśca sājyāḥ sekā
                            yojanīyāśca lepāḥ/

vānte samyak cāvapīḍaṃ vadanti tīkṣṇaṃ dhūmaṃ
                            śodhanaṃ cātra nasyam/
kṣepyaṃ nasyaṃ mūrdhavairecanīyairnāḍyā cūrṇaṃ kṣavathau bhraṃśathau ca//

kuryāt svedān mūrdhni vātāmayaghnān snigdhān
                            dhūmān yadyanyaddhitaṃ ca/
dīpte roge paittikaṃ saṃvidhānaṃ kuryāt sarvaṃ svādu yacchītalaṃ ca//

nāsānāhe snehapānaṃ pradhānaṃ snigdhā dhūmā
                            mūrdhabastiśca nityam/

nāsāsrāve ghrāṇataścūrṇamuktaṃ nāḍyā deyaṃ
                            yo+avapīḍaśca tīkṣṇaḥ/
tīkṣṇaṃ dhūmaṃ devadārvagnikābhyāṃ māṃsaṃ vā++ājaṃ yuktamatrādiśanti//

nāsāśoṣe kṣīrasarpiḥ pradhānaṃ siddhaṃ tailaṃ
                            cāṇukalpena nasyam/
sarpiḥpānaṃ bhojanaṃ jāṅgalaiśca snehaḥ svedaḥ snaihikaścāpi dhūmaḥ//

śeṣān rogān ghrāṇajān sanniyaccheduktaṃ teṣāṃ
                            yadyathā saṃvidhānam//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre
                        nāsāgatarogapratiṣedho nāma trayoviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ //23//

cayaṃ gatā mūrdhani mārutādayaḥ pṛthak
                            samastāśca tathaiva śoṇitam/
prakopyamāṇā vividhaiḥ prakopaṇairnṛṇāṃ pratiśyāyakarā bhavanti hi//
uṣṇaḥ sapītakaḥ srāvo ghrāṇāt sravati paittike//
sadhūmaṃ sahasā vahniṃ vamatīva ca mānavaḥ//

saṃpakvo vā+apyapakvo vā sa sarvaprabhavaḥ
                            smṛtaḥ/
liṅgāni caiva sarveṣāṃ pīnasānāṃ ca sarvaje//

navaṃ pratiśyāyamapāsya sarvamupācaret sarpiṣa
                            eva pānaiḥ/

apacyamānasya hi pācanārthaṃ svedo
                            hito+amlairahimaṃ ca bhojyam/

nivātaśayyāsanaceṣṭanāni mūrdhno gurūṣṇaṃ ca
                            tathaiva vāsaḥ/
śokaṃ ca madyāni navāni caiva vivarjayet pīnasarogajuṣṭaḥ//
ubhe bale bṛhatyau ca viḍaṅgaṃ satrikaṇṭakam//
mustā tejovatī pāṭhā kaṭphalaṃ kaṭukā vacā/

tutthaṃ karañjabījaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ bhadradāru
                            ca/
etaiḥ kṛtaṃ kaṣāyaṃ tu kavale saṃprayojayet//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre
                        pratiśyāyapratiṣedho nāma caturviṃśatitamo+adhyāyaḥ //24//

yasyānimittaṃ śiraso rujaśca bhavanti tīvrā niśi
                            cātimātram/
śītena rātrau ca bhavedviśeṣaḥ śirobhitāpaḥ sa tu pittakopāt//

śirogalaṃ yasya kaphopadigdhaṃ guru
                            pratiṣṭabdhamatho himaṃ ca/
śūnākṣikūṭaṃ vadanaṃ ca yasya śirobhitāpaḥ sa kaphaprakopāt//

ghrāṇācca gacchetsalilaṃ saraktaṃ śirobhitāpaḥ
                            kṛmibhiḥ sa ghoraḥ/
sūryodayaṃ yā prati mandamandamakṣibhruvaṃ ruk samupaiti gāḍham//

vivardhate cāṃśumatā sahaiva sūryāpavṛttau
                            vinivartate ca/
śītena śāntiṃ labhate kadāciduṣṇena jantuḥ sukhamāpnuyācca//
doṣāstu duṣṭāstraya eva manyāṃ saṃpīḍya ghāṭāsu rujāṃ sutīvrām//

kurvanti sākṣibhruvi śaṅkhadeśe sthitiṃ
                            karotyāśu viśeṣatastu/
gaṇḍasya pārśve tu karoti kampaṃ hanugrahaṃ locanajāṃśca rogān//

rujaḥ sutīvrāḥ pratanoti mūrdhni viśeṣataścāpi
                            hi śaṅkhayostu/
sukaṣṭamenaṃ khalu śaṅkhakākhyaṃ maharṣayo vedavidaḥ purāṇāḥ//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre
                        śirorogavijñānīyo nāma pañcaviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ //25//

pibedvā payasā tailaṃ tatkalkaṃ vā+api
                            mānavaḥ/

tato madhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ nasye tat pūjitaṃ
                            haviḥ/
tasmin vipakve kṣīre tu peyaṃ sarpiḥ saśarkaram//

kṣīrasarpirhitaṃ nasyaṃ vasā vā jāṅgalā
                            śubhā/
sarpiḥpānaṃ viśeṣeṇa purāṇaṃ vā diśanti hi//
pāne nasye ca sarpiḥ syādvātaghnamadhuraiḥ śṛtam//

nasye hi śoṇitaṃ dadyāttena mūrcchanti
                            jantavaḥ/
kṣīrasarpiḥ praśaṃsanti nasye pāne ca śaṅkhake//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre
                        śirorogapratiṣedho nāma ṣaṅviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ //26//
trastān hṛṣṭāṃtarjitān tāḍitān vā pūjāhetorhiṃsyurete kumārān//

aiśvaryasthāste na śakyā viśanto dehaṃ draṣṭuṃ
                            mānuṣairviśvarūpāḥ/
āptaṃ vākyaṃ tatsamīkṣyābhidhāsye liṅgānyeṣāṃ yāni dehe bhavanti//
udvigraḥ sululitacakṣuralparodī skandārto bhavati ca gāḍhamuṣṭivarcāḥ//

niḥsaṃjño bhavati punarbhavetsasaṃjñaḥ
                            saṃrabdhaḥ karacaraṇaiśca nṛtyatīva/

viṇmūtre sṛjati vinadya jṛmbhamāṇaḥ phenaṃ ca prasṛjati
                            tatsakhābhipannaḥ//

sphoṭaiśca pracitatanuḥ sadāhapākairvijñeyo bhavati śiśuḥ kṣataḥ
                            śakunyā//
revatyā viyathitatanuśca karṇanāsaṃ mṛdgāti dhruvamabhipīḍitaḥ kumāraḥ//

srastāṅgaḥ svapiti sukhaṃ divā na rātrau viḍ
                            bhinnaṃ sṛjati ca kākatulyagandhiḥ/

udvigro bhṛśamativepate prarudyāt saṃlīnaḥ
                            ssvapiti ca yasya cāntrakūjaḥ/
visrāṅgo bhṛśamatisāryate ca yastaṃ jānīyādbhiṣagiha śītapūtanārtam//

sodvego bhavati ca mūtratulyagandhiḥ sa jñeyaḥ śiśuriha
                            vaktramaṇḍikārtaḥ//

yaḥ phenaṃ vamati vinamyate ca madhye sodvegaṃ
                            vilapati cordhvamīkṣamāṇaḥ/
jvaryeta pratatamatho vasāsagandhirniḥsaṃjño bhavati hi naigameṣajuṣṭaḥ//

teṣāṃ mūleṣu siddhaṃ ca tailamabhyañjane
                            hitam/

raktāni mālyāni tathā patākā raktāśca gandhā
                            vividhāśca bhakṣyāḥ/
ghaṇṭā ca devāya balirnivedyaḥ sukukkuṭaḥ skandagrahe hitāya//

snānaṃ trirātraṃ niśi catvareṣu kuryāt puraṃ
                            śāliyavairnavaistu/

tapasāṃ tejasāṃ caiva yaśasāṃ vapuṣāṃ
                            tathā/
nidhānaṃ yo+avyayo devaḥ sa te skandaḥ prasīdatu//
devadevasya mahataḥ pāvakasya ca yaḥ sutaḥ/
gaṅgomākṛttikānāṃ ca sa te śarma prayacchatu//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre skandapratiṣedho
                        nāmā (dvitīyo+adhyāyaḥ, ādito+)aṣṭāviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ //28//
bilvaḥ śirīṣo golomī surasādiśca yo gaṇaḥ/
vipaktavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ cāpi pānīyaṃ payasā saha/

anantāṃ kukkuṭīṃ bimbīṃ markaṭīṃ cāpi
                            dhārayet/

lakṣmaṇāṃ sahadevāṃ ca bṛhatīṃ cāpi
                            dhārayet/
kuryācca vividhāṃ pūjāṃ śakunyāḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre śakunīpratiṣedho
                        nāma (caturtho+adhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) triṃśo+adhyāyaḥ //30//
aśvagandhā ca śṛṅgī ca sārivā sapunarnavā/
sahe tathā vidārī ca kaṣāyāḥ secane hitāḥ//
śuklāḥ sumanaso lājāḥ payaḥ śālyodanaṃ tathā//
revatī śuṣkanāmā yā sā te devī prasīdatu//

iti suśurtasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre revatīpratiṣedho
                        nāma (pañcamo+adhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ekatriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ//31//

hitaṃ ghṛtaṃ tugākṣīryāṃ siddhaṃ madhurakeṣu
                            ca/
karkaṭāsthi ghṛtaṃ cāpi dhūpanaṃ sarṣapaiḥ saha//

kākādanīṃ citraphalāṃ bimbīṃ guñjāṃ ca
                            dhārayet/
matsyaudanaṃ ca kurvīta kṛśarāṃ palalaṃ tathā/
pūjyā ca pūtanā devī balibhiḥ sopahārakaiḥ//
māṃsamāmaṃ tathā pakvaṃ śoṇitaṃ ca catuṣpathe//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate
                        kumāratantre+andhapūtanāpratiṣedho nāma (saptamo+adhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ)
                        trayastriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ //33//

kapitthaṃ suvahāṃ bimbīṃ tathā bilvaṃ
                            pracībalam/

bastamūtraṃ gavāṃ mūtraṃ mustaṃ ca suradāru
                            ca/

dhārayedapi lambāṃ ca guñjāṃ kākādanīṃ
                            tathā/
tailaṃ vasāṃ ca saṃyojya pacedabhyañjane śiśoḥ//
madhure pañcamūle ca kanīyasi ghṛtaṃ pacet//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre
                        mukhamaṇḍikāpratiṣedho nāma (navamo+adhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ)
                        pañcatriṃśattamo+adhyāyaḥ //35//
surā sabījaṃ dhānyāmlaṃ pariṣeke ca śasyate//

vacāṃ vayaḥsthāṃ golomīṃ jaṭilāṃ cāpi
                            dhārayet/
dhūpaḥ supte jane kāryo bālasya hitamicchatā//

nava skandādayaḥ proktā bālānāṃ ya ime
                            grahāḥ/
strīvigrahā grahā ye tu nānārūpā mayeritāḥ/
sa ca skandasakhā nāma viśākha iti cocyate//
bibharti cāparāṃ saṃjñāṃ kumāra iti sa grahaḥ//

ūcuḥ prāñjalayaścainaṃ vṛttiṃ naḥ saṃvidhatsva
                            vai/
bhāgadheyaṃ vibhaktaṃ ca śeṣaṃ kiñcinna vidyate//
kuleṣu yeṣu nejyante devāḥ pitara eva ca//

tatra vo vipulā vṛttiḥ pūjā caiva
                            bhaviṣyati/
evaṃ grahāḥ samutpannā bālān gṛhṇanti cāpyataḥ//
vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ cāpi dhruvaṃ skandagrahe matam//
anyo vā sarvarūpastu na sādhyo graha ucyate//

jāyante bījadoṣācca daivācca śṛṇu tāḥ
                            pṛthak/
udāvartā tathā vandhyā viplutā ca pariplutā//
vāminī snāṃsinī cāpi putraghnī pittalā ca yā//
atyānandā ca yā yoniḥ karṇinī caraṇādvayam

prasraṃsinī syandate tu kṣobhitā duḥprasūśca
                            yā/
sthitaṃ sthitaṃ hanti garbhaṃ putraghnī raktasaṃsravāt//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre
                        yonivyāpatpratiṣedho nāma (dvādaśo+adhyāyaḥ,
                        ādito+)aṣṭatriṃśattamo+adhyāyaḥ//38//
janmādau nidhane caiva prāyo viśati dehinam
ṛte devamanuṣyebhyo nānyo viṣahate tu tam/
doṣāḥ prakupitāḥ sveṣu kāleṣu svaiḥ prakopaṇaiḥ//

janayatyatha vṛddhiṃ vā svavarṇaṃ ca
                            tvagādiṣu/
nidrānāśaḥ kṣutaḥ stambho gātrāṇāṃ raukṣyameva ca//

pralāpaḥ kaṭutā vaktre mūrcchā dāho
                            madastṛṣā/
tṛṣṇā moho madaḥ stambho dāhaḥ śītaṃ hṛdi vyathā//
sarvaje sarvaliṅgāni viśeṣaṃ cātra me śṛṇu//
saptame vidase prāpte daśame dvādaśe+api vā//

punardhorataro bhūtvā praśamaṃ yāti hanti
                            vā/

tṛṣṇā mūrcchā bhramo dāhaḥ svapnanāśaḥ
                            śirorujā/
staimityaṃ parvaṇaṃ bhedo nidrā gauravameva ca//

paro hetuḥ svabhāvo vā viṣame
                            kaiścidīritaḥ/
aupatyake madyasamudbhave ca hetuṃ jvare pittakṛtaṃ vadanti//

pralepakaṃ vātabalāsakaṃ ca kaphādhikatvena
                            vadanti tajjñāḥ/
mūrcchānubandhā viṣamajvarā ye prāyeṇa te dvandvasamutthitāstu//

karotyādau tathā pittaṃ tvaksthaṃ dāhamatīva
                            ca/
rātryahnoḥ ṣaṭsu kāleṣu kīrtiteṣu tathā purā//
sa cāpi viṣamo dehaṃ na kadācidvimuñcati//
saptāhaṃ vā daśāhaṃ vā dvādaśāhamathāpi vā/

yathādoṣaprakopaṃ tu tathā manyeta taṃ
                            jvaram/

abhaktaruk pipāsā ca todo mūrcchā
                            balakṣayaḥ/
hṛdaye vedanā cāsya gātraṃ ca pariśuṣyati//

bhayāt pralāpaḥ śokācca bhavet kopācca
                            vepathuḥ/
rasasthe tu jvare liṅgaṃ dainyaṃ cāsyopajāyate//
pralāpaḥ piṭikā tṛṣṇā raktaprāpte jvare nṛṇām//

śephasaḥ stabdhatā mokṣaḥ śukrasya tu
                            viśeṣataḥ/
dagdhvendhanaṃ yathā vahnirdhātūn hatvā yathā viṣam//

kṛtakṛtyo vrajecchāntiṃ dehaṃ hatvā tathā
                            jvaraḥ/
pāyayeta ghṛtaṃ svacchaṃ tataḥ sa labhate sukham//

āmāśayasthe doṣe tu sotkleśe vamanaṃ
                            param/

annakāle hitā peyā yathāsvaṃ pācanaiḥ
                            kṛtā/

(tīkṣṇe jvare gurau dehe vibaddheṣu maleṣu
                            ca/

//) mṛdau jvare laghau dehe pracaleṣu maleṣu
                            ca/

svāpaḥ stambho gurutvaṃ ca gātrāṇāṃ
                            vahnimārdavam/
yadā koṣṭhānugāḥ pakvā vibaddhāḥ srotasāṃ malāḥ//
pakvo hyanirhṛto doṣo dehe tiṣṭhan mahātyayam//

kramaśaḥ baline deyaṃ vamanaṃ ślaiṣmike
                            jvare/

śuddhasyobhayato yasya jvaraḥ śāntiṃ na
                            gacchati/

sa eva sitayā yuktaḥ śītaḥ pittajvare
                            hitaḥ/
pipāsārtaḥ sadāho vā payasā sa sukhī bhavet//
sa kṣīṇaḥ kṛcchratāṃ yāti yātyasādhyatvameva ca//

tasmādrakṣedbalaṃ puṃsāṃ bale sati hi
                            jīvitam/

na tu tasyāhitaṃ bhuktamāyuṣe vā sukhāya
                            vā/
jvaritānāṃ prakopaṃ tu yadā yāti samīraṇaḥ//
na seveta jvarotsṛṣṭo yāvanna balavān bhavet//
śṛtaṃ śītakaṣāyaṃ vā guḍūcyāḥ peyameva tu/

vairasye dhārayetkalkaṃ gaṇḍūṣaṃ ca tathā
                            hitam/
saptacchadaṃ guḍūcīṃ ca nimbaṃ sphūrjakameva ca//

kvāthayitvā pibet kvāthaṃ sakṣaudraṃ kaphaje
                            jvare/

kauṭajaṃ ca phalaṃ hanyāt sevyamānaṃ
                            kaphajvaram/
mustena ca kṛtaḥ kvāthaḥ pīto hanyāt kaphajvaram//

niṣkvāthya vātapittotthe taṃ kvāthaṃ saguḍaṃ
                            pibet/

ekaśo vā dviśo vā+api jvaraghnāni
                            prayojayet/
jvare tu viṣame kāryamūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca śodhanam//
gavyaṃ dadhi ca mūtraṃ ca kṣīraṃ sarpiḥ śakṛdrasaḥ//

viḍaṅgaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ cavyaṃ suradāru tathaiva
                            ca/
balayā+atha paraṃ pācyaṃ guḍūcyā tadvadeva tu//

jīrṇajvare ca śophe ca pāṇḍuroge ca
                            pūjitam/
etenaiva tu kalpena ghṛtaṃ pañcāvikaṃ pacet/
śṛtaṃ payaḥ śarkarā ca pippalyo madhusarpiṣī//
ṣaḍguṇena ca takreṇa siddhaṃ tailaṃ jvarāntakṛt//
madyaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ pāyayeta ghṛtaṃ vā jvaranāśanam//

purāṇaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ kāmamudāraṃ vā
                            virecanam/
kalpoktaṃ cājitaṃ sarpiḥ sevyamānaṃ jvaraṃ jayet//

jayet kaṣāyaṃ ca hitaṃ sarvagandhakṛtaṃ
                            tathā/
prahlādaṃ cāsya vijñāya tāḥ strīrapanayet punaḥ//

prahlādaṃ cāsya vijñāya tāḥ strīrapanayet
                            punaḥ/
hitaṃ ca bhojayedannaṃ tathā++āpnoti sukhaṃ mahat//

līḍvā cūrṇāni madhunā sarpiṣā ca
                            jayedvamim/
kāse śvāse ca madhunā sarpiṣā ca sukhī bhavet//
vairasye dhārayet kalkaṃ gaṇḍūṣaṃ ca yathāhitam//
śūnye mūrdhni hitaṃ nasyaṃ jīvanīyaśṛtaṃ ghṛtam//

pakve pittajvare rakte cordhvage vepathau
                            tathā/

avekṣya doṣaṃ
                            prāṇaṃ ca yathāsvaṃ cānuvāsanāḥ/
saṃsarge sannipāte ca saṃsṛṣṭā bastayo hitāḥ//

vinā tailaṃ ta eva syuryojyā mārutaje
                            jvare/

hṛtāvaśeṣaṃ pittaṃ tu tvaksthaṃ janayati
                            jvaram/
tenāntareṇāśayaṃ svaṃ gatā doṣā bhavanti hi//

laghutvaṃ śirasaḥ svedo mukhamāpāṇḍu pāki
                            ca/
vṛddho+atīvādhaḥ saratyeṣa yasmādvyādhiṃ ghoraṃ taṃ tvatīsāramāhuḥ//

ekaikaśaḥ sarvaśaścāpi doṣaiḥ śokenānyaḥ ṣaṣṭha
                            āmena coktaḥ/

varco muñcatyalpamalpaṃ saphenaṃ rūkṣaṃ śyāvaṃ
                            sānilaṃ mārutena/

śuklaṃ sāndraṃ śleṣmaṇā śleṣmayuktaṃ
                            bhaktadveṣī niḥsvanaṃ hṛṣṭaromā/

koṣṭhaṃ gatvā kṣobhayatyasya raktaṃ
                            taccādhastāt kākaṇantīprakāśam/
varcomiśraṃ niḥpurīṣaṃ sagandhaṃ nirgandhaṃ vā sāryate tena kṛcchrāt//

śokotpanno duścikitsyo+atimātraṃ rogo vaidyaiḥ
                            kaṣṭa eṣa pradiṣṭaḥ/
āmājīrṇopadrutāḥ kṣobhayantaḥ koṣṭhaṃ doṣāḥ saṃpraduṣṭāḥ sabhaktam//

nānāvarṇaṃ naikaśaḥ sārayanti kṛcchrājjantoḥ
                            ṣaṣṭhamenaṃ vadanti/
etānyeva tu liṅgāni viparītāni yasya tu/
lāghavaṃ ca manuṣyasya tasya pakvaṃ vinirdiśet//
mañjiṣṭhābhaṃ mastuluṅgopamaṃ vā visraṃ śītaṃ pretagandhyañjanābham//

rājīmadvā candrakaiḥ santataṃ vā pūyaprakhyaṃ
                            kardamābhaṃ tathoṣṇam/
hanyādetadyat pratīpaṃ bhavecca kṣīṇaṃ hanyuścopasargāḥ prabhūtāḥ//
anena vidhinā cāmaṃ yasya vai nopaśāmyati/
haridrādiṃ vacādiṃ vā pibet prātaḥ sa mānavaḥ//

stokaṃ stokaṃ vibaddhaṃ vā saśūlaṃ
                            yo+atisāryate/
āme ca laṅghanaṃ śastamādau pācanameva vā/

abhayā dhānyakaṃ mustaṃ pippalī nāgaraṃ
                            vacā/
nāgaraṃ dhānyakaṃ mustaṃ vālakaṃ bilvameva ca//

elā sāvarakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ haridre kauṭajā
                            yavāḥ/
meṣaśṛṅgī tvagele ca kṛmighnaṃ vṛkṣakāṇi ca//
aralutvak taindukī ca dāḍimī kauṭajī śamī//

pāṭhā tejovatī mustaṃ pippalī kauṭajaṃ
                            phalam/
paṭolaṃ(paṭolī) dīpyako bilvaṃ haridre devadāru ca//
niṣkvāthān vā pibedeṣāṃ sukhoṣṇān sādhu sādhitān//

mustaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ ca pibedvā+api
                            sukhāmbunā/
citrakaṃ śiṃśapā pāṭhā śārṅgeṣṭā lavaṇāni ca//
ete sukhāmbunā yogā deyāḥ paśca satāṃ matāḥ//
rasāñjanaṃ haridre dve bījāni kuṭajasya ca//

pāṭhā mustaṃ haridre dve pippalī kauṭajaṃ
                            phalam/
payo ghṛtaṃ ca madhu ca pibecchūlairabhidrutaḥ//
tittiriṃ luñcitaṃ samyak niṣkṛṣṭāntraṃ tu pūrayet//

hitaḥ snehavireko vā bastayaḥ picchilāśca
                            ye/

gaurave vamanaṃ pathyaṃ yasya syāt prabalaḥ
                            kaphaḥ/

jvaraṃ śūlaṃ tṛṣāṃ dāhaṃ gudapākaṃ ca
                            dāruṇam/
yo raktaṃ śakṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ paścādvā pratisāryate//

tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ sayaṣṭyāhvāḥ samaṅgā cotpalāni
                            ca/
sakṣaudratailaṃ prāgeva lihyādāśu hitaṃ hi tat//

kośakāraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ lājacūrṇaṃ sitā
                            madhu/

gudāpāke ca ye uktāste+atrāpi vidhayaḥ
                            smṛtāḥ/

dadhnaḥ saraśca yamake bhṛṣṭo varcaḥkṣaye
                            hitaḥ/
pravāhamāṇasya muhurmalāktaṃ pravāhikāṃ tāṃ pravadanti tajjñāḥ//

pravāhikā vātakṛtā saśūlā pittāt sadāhā
                            sakaphā kaphācca/
saśoṇitā śoṇitasaṃbhavā tu tāḥ sneharūkṣaprabhavā matāstu//
na śāntimāyāti vilaṅghanairyā yogairudīrṇā yadi pācanairvā//

tāṃ kṣīramevāśu śṛtaṃ nihanti tailaṃ tilāḥ
                            picchilabastayaśca/
ārdraiḥ kuśaiḥ saṃpariveṣṭitāni vṛntānyathārdrāṇi hi śālmalīnām//
kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ tailahavirvimiśraṃ kalkena yaṣṭīmadhukasya vā+api//
vātaghnavarge lavaṇeṣu caiva tailaṃ ca siddhaṃ hitamannapāne//

lodhraṃ viḍaṃ bilvaśalāṭu caiva lihyācca
                            tailena kaṭutrikāḍhyam/
khādecca matsyān rasamāpnuyācca vātaghnasiddhaṃ saghṛtaṃ satailam//

eṇāvyajānāṃ tu vaṭapravālaiḥ siddhāni sārdhaṃ
                            piśitāni khādet/

medhyasya(medyasya) siddhaṃ tvatha vā+api raktaṃ bastasya dadhnā
                            ghṛtatailayuktam//

khādet pradehaiḥ śikhilāvajairvā bhuñjīta
                            yūṣairdadhibhiśca mukhyaiḥ/
māṣān susiddhān ghṛtamaṇḍayuktān khādecca dadhnā maricopadaṃśān//

sa bastiḥ śamayettasya raktaṃ dāhamatho
                            jvaram/

rātrāvahani vā nityaṃ rujārto yo
                            bhavennaraḥ/

praśānte mārute cāpi śāntiṃ yāti
                            pravāhikā/
sukhāmbupītāḥ śamayanti rogaṃ medhyāṇḍasiddhaṃ saghṛtaṃ payo vā//

śuṇṭhīṃ ghṛtaṃ sakṣavakaṃ satailaṃ vipācya
                            līḍhvā++āmayamāśu hanyāt/

bilvānvitā pathyatamā yavāgūrdhāroṣṇadugdhasya
                            tathā ca pānam/

hitāya nityaṃ vitaredvibhajya yogāṃśca tāṃstān
                            bhiṣagapramattaḥ//
jvare caivātisāre ca yavāgūḥ sarvadā hitā//

ṣaṣṭhī pittadharā nāma yā kalā
                            parikīrtitā/

grahaṇyā balamagnirhi sa cāpi grahaṇīṃ
                            śritaḥ/

pakvaṃ vā sarujaṃ pūti muhurbaddhaṃ
                            muhurdravam/

takreṇa vā+atha takraṃ vā kevalaṃ
                            hitamucyate/

cūrṇaṃ hiṅgvādikaṃ cātra ghṛtaṃ vā
                            plīhanāśanam/

caturguṇena dadhnā ca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ hitaṃ
                            bhavet/

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate
                        kāyacikitsātantre+atisārapratiṣedho nāma (dvitīyo+adhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ/)
                        catvāriṃśo+adhyāyaḥ //40//
eka eva mataḥ śoṣaḥ sannipātātmako hyataḥ//
kṣīyante dhātavaḥ sarve tataḥ śuṣyanti mānavaḥ//
tasyorasi kṣate raktaṃ pūyaḥ śleṣmā ca gacchati//
kṣayā eva hi te jñeyāḥ pratyekaṃ dhātusaṃjñitāḥ//

cikitsitaṃ tu teṣāṃ hi prāguktaṃ
                            dhātusaṃkṣaye//

śoṣe bhaviṣyati bhavanti sa cāpi jantuḥ śuklekṣaṇe bhavati māṃsaparo
                            ririṃsuḥ//

taṃ vāhayanti sa nadīrvijalāśca paśyecchuṣkāṃstarūn
                            pavanadhūmadavārditāṃśca//

khādet pibet sarpirajāvikaṃ vā kṛśo yavāgvā
                            saha bhaktakāle/

māṃsādamāṃseṣu ghṛtaṃ ca siddhaṃ śosāpahaṃ
                            kṣaudrakaṇāsametam/
tadutthitaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ sitāḍhyaṃ prātaḥ pibedvā+api payonupānam//

utsādane cāpi turaṅgagandhā yojyā yavāścaiva
                            punarnave ca/
kṛtsne vṛṣe tatkusumaiśca siddhaṃ sarpiḥ pibetkṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī//

yakṣmāṇametat prabalaṃ ca kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ ca
                            hanyādapi pāṇḍutāṃ ca/
śakṛdrasā gośvagajāvyajānāṃ kvāthā mitāścāpi tathaiva bhāgaiḥ//
bhāgān daśautān vipacedvidhijño dattvā trivargaṃ madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnam//
dve pañcamūlyau varuṇaṃ karañjaṃ bhallātakaṃ bilvapunarnave ca//

yavān kulatthān badarāṇi bhārgīṃ pāṭhāṃ hutāśaṃ
                            samahīkadambam/
kṛtvā kaṣāyaṃ vipaceddhi tasya ṣaḍbhirhi pātrairghṛtapātramekam//

vyoṣaṃ mahāvṛkṣapayo+abhayāṃ ca cavyaṃ
                            surākhyaṃ lavaṇottamaṃ ca/
etaddhi śoṣaṃ jaṭharāṇi caiva hanyāt pramehāṃśca sahānilena//

paktvā jale tena paceddhi sarpistasmin susiddhe
                            tvavatārite ca/
triṃśatpalānyatra sitopalāyā dattvā tugākṣīripalāni ṣaṭ ca//

prasthe ghṛtasya dviguṇaṃ ca dadyāt kṣaudraṃ
                            tato manthahataṃ vidadhyāt/
palaṃ palaṃ prātarataḥ pralihya paścāt pibet kṣīramatandritaśca//

etaddhi medhyaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ
                            cakṣuṣyamāyuṣyamatho yaśasyam/
yakṣmāṇamāśu vyapahanti caitat pāṇḍvāmayaṃ caiva bhagandaraṃ ca//
na cātra kiṃcit parivarjanīyaṃ rasāyanaṃ caitadupāsyamānam//

plīhodaroktaṃ vihitaṃ ca sarpistrīṇyeva cānyāni
                            hitāni cātra/

rasonayogaṃ vidhivat kṣayārtaḥ kṣīreṇa vā
                            nāgabalāprayogam/

śokaṃ striyaṃ krodhamasūyanaṃ ca tyajedudārān
                            viṣayān bhajeta/
vaidyān dvijātīṃstridaśān gurūśca vācaśca puṇyāḥ śṛṇuyādbijebhyaḥ//
janayanti nṛṇāṃ gulmaṃ sa pañcavidha ucyate//
cayāpacayavān vṛttaḥ sa gulma iti kīrtitaḥ//

puruṣāṇāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ jñeyo raktena
                            cāparaḥ/
te te vikārāḥ pavanātmakāśca bhavanti gulme+anilasaṃbhave tu//
pittasya liṅgānyakhilāni yāni pittātmake tāni bhavanti gulme//
kaphasya liṅgāni ca yāni tāni bhavanti gulme kaphasaṃbhave tu//

sarvātmakaḥ sarvavikārayuktaḥ so+asādhya uktaḥ
                            kṣatajaṃ pravakṣye/

vāyurhi tasyāḥ parigṛhya raktaṃ karoti gulmaṃ
                            sarujaṃ sadāham/
paittasya liṅgena samānaliṅgaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ cāpyaparaṃ nibodha//

na spandate nodarameti vṛddhiṃ bhavanti liṅgāni
                            ca garbhiṇīnām/
cūrṇaṃ hiṅgvādikaṃ vā+api ghṛtaṃ vā plīhanāśanam//
tasya mātrāṃ pibeddadhnā surayā sarpiṣā+api vā//

lavaṇaṃ vṛkṣabījaṃ ca tulyaṃ syādanavo
                            guḍaḥ/

gulme raktaṃ jalaukobhiḥ sirāmokṣeṇa vā
                            haret/
peyā vātaharaiḥ siddhāḥ kaulatthāḥ saṃskṛtā rasāḥ//

ūrdhvavātaṃ manuṣyaṃ ca gulminaṃ na
                            nirūhayet/

gugguluṃ trivṛtāṃ dantīṃ dravantīṃ saindhavaṃ
                            vacām/

yuktā hanti surā gulmaṃ śīghraṃ kāle
                            prayojitā/
na khādedālukaṃ gulmī madhurāṇi phalāni ca/

nidānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi rūpaṃ ca
                            sacikitsitam/

tṛṣṇā dāho mado mūrcchā tīvraṃ śūlaṃ tathaiva
                            ca/

śūlānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ cikitsāṃ tu nibodha
                            me/
tāni cūrṇāni payasā pibet kāmbalikena vā//

guḍatailena vā līḍhā pītā madyena vā
                            punaḥ/

sa sukhaṃ chardayitvā tu pītvā śītodakaṃ
                            naraḥ/

aśane bhuktamātre tu prakopaḥ ślaiṣmikasya
                            ca/

rūkṣaḥ svedaḥ prayojyaḥ syādanyāścoṣṇāḥ kriyā
                            hitāḥ/
saindhavaṃ tumburuṃ pathyāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tu pāyayet//
sarpiḥ plīhodaroktaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ vā hiṅgusaṃyutam//

tadā+asya bhojanaṃ bhuktaṃ sopastambhaṃ na
                            pacyate/

nāgaraṃ dīpyakaṃ cavyaṃ hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ
                            viḍam/
malaṃ ruṇaddhi koṣṭhasthaṃ mandīkṛtya tu pāvakam//
dakṣiṇaṃ yadi vā vāmaṃ kukṣimādāya jāyate//
pipāsā vardhate tīvrā bhramo mūrcchā ca jāyate//

kṣipraṃ doṣaharaṃ kāryaṃ bhiṣajā sādhu
                            jānatā/

atimātraṃ yadā bhuktaṃ pāvake mṛdutāṃ
                            gate/

guṭikāḥ śasyante śūlanāśanāḥ// gulmāvasthāḥ kriyāḥ kāryā yathāvat
                            sarvaśūlinām//
dūṣayitvā rasaṃ doṣā viguṇā hṛdayaṃ gatāḥ/
kurvanti hṛdaye bādhāṃ hṛdrogaṃ taṃ pracakṣate//
nirmathyate dīryate ca sphoṭyate pāṭyate+api ca//
dhūmāyanaṃ ca mūrcchā ca svedaḥ śoṣo mukhasya ca//
kṛmije kṛmijātīnāṃ ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ ca ye matāḥ//

vyavāyamamlaṃ lavaṇāni madyaṃ mṛdaṃ
                            divāsvapnamatīva tīkṣṇam/
niṣevamāṇasya vidūṣya raktaṃ kurvanti doṣāstvaci pāṇḍubhāvam//
sarveṣu caiteṣviha pāṇḍubhāvo yato+adhiko+ataḥ khalu pāṇḍurogaḥ//

sarvātmake sarvamidaṃ vyavasyed vakṣyāmi
                            liṅgānyatha kāmalāyāḥ/
yo hyāmayānte sahasā+annamamlamadyādapathyāni ca tasya pittam//
bhedastu tasyāḥ khalu kumbhasāhvaḥ śopho mahāṃstatra ca parvabhedaḥ//
śophastathā kaṇṭhagato+abalatvaṃ mūrcchā klamo hṛdyavapīḍanaṃ ca//

sādhyaṃ tu pāṇḍvāmayinaṃ samīkṣya snigdhaṃ
                            ghṛtenordhvamadhaśca śuddham/

pibedghṛtaṃ vā rajanīvipakvaṃ yantraiphalaṃ
                            tailvakameva vā+api/
dhātrīphalānāṃ rasamikṣujaṃ ca manthaṃ pibet kṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī//

ubhe bṛhatyau rajanīṃ śukākhyāṃ kākādanīṃ cāpi
                            sakākamācīm/

tat pāṇḍutāṃ hantyupayujyamānaṃ kṣīeṇa vā
                            māgadhikā yathāgni/

bibhītakāyomalanāgarāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ tilānāṃ ca
                            guḍaśca mukhyaḥ/

takrānupāno vaṭakaḥ
                            prayuktaḥ kṣiṇoti ghorānapi pāṇḍurogān//

sauvarcalaṃ hiṅgu kirātatiktaṃ kalāyamātrāṇi
                            sukhāmbunā vā/
mūrvāharidrāmalakaṃ ca lihyāt sthitaṃ gavāṃ saptadināni mūtre//
sukhāmbunā vā lavaṇena tulyaṃ śigroḥ phalaṃ kṣīrabhujopayojyam//

nyagrodhavargasya pibet kaṣāyaṃ śītaṃ
                            sitākṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī/
śālādikaṃ cāpyatha sāracūrṇaṃ dhātrīphalaṃ vā madhunā+avalihyāt//
cūrṇāni kṛtvā guḍaśarkare ca tathaiva sarpirmadhunī śume ca//
jātaṃ ca lehyaṃ matimān viditvā nidhāpayenmokṣakaje samudge//

hantyeṣa lehaḥ khalu pāṇḍurogaṃ
                            saśothamugrāmapi kāmalāṃ ca/
saśarkarā kāmalināṃ tribhaṇḍī hitā gavākṣī saguḍā ca śuṇṭhī//

kāleyake cāpi ghṛtaṃ vipakvaṃ hitaṃ ca tat
                            syādrajanīvimiśram/
dhātuṃ nadījaṃ jatu śailajaṃ vā kumbhāhvaye

mūtre sthitaṃ saindhavasaṃprayuktaṃ māsaṃ
                            pibedvā+api hi lohakiṭṭam/

vicūrṇya līḍhaṃ madhunā+acireṇa kumbhāhvayaṃ
                            pāṇḍugadaṃ nihanyāt/
sindhūdbhavaṃ vā+agnisamaṃ ca kṛtvā kṣiptvā ca mūtre sakṛdeva taptam//

lauhaṃ ca kiṭṭaṃ bahuśaśca taptvā nirvāpya
                            mūtre bahuśastathaiva/

yathā na dahyeta tathā viśuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ
                            peyamudaśvitā tat/
takraudanāśī vijayeta rogaṃ pāṇḍuṃ tathā dīpayate+analaṃ ca//

drākṣāguḍūcyāmalakīrasaiśca siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ
                            lāgharake(lāghavake) hitaṃ ca/

snigdhān rasānāmalakairupetān kolānvitān vā+api
                            hi jāṅgalānām/
seveta śophābhihitāṃśca yogān pāṇḍvāmayī śāliyavāṃśca nityam//

anteṣu śūnaṃ parihīnamadhyaṃ mlānaṃ
                            tathā+anteṣu ca madhyaśūnam/

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre
                        pāṇḍurogapratiṣedho nāma (ṣaṣṭho+adhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ)
                        catuścatvāriṃśattamo+adhyāyaḥ //44//

tataḥ pravartate raktamūrdhvaṃ cādho dvidhā+api
                            vā/

daurbalyaśvāsakāsajvaravamathumadāstandritādāhamūrcchā bhukte cānne
                            vidāhastvadhṛtirapi sadā hṛdyatulyā ca pīḍā/

davanaṃ pūtiniṣṭhīvanaṃ ca dveṣo bhakte+avipāko
                            viratirapi rate raktapittopasargāḥ//

māṃsaprakṣālanābhaṃ kvathitamiva ca yat
                            kardamāmbhonibhaṃ vā medaḥpūyāsrakalpaṃ

yat kṛṣṇaṃ yacca nīlaṃ bhṛśamatikuṇapaṃ yatra coktā vikārāstadvarjyaṃ
                            raktapittaṃ surapatidhanuṣā yacca tulyaṃ vibhāti//
tarpaṇaṃ pācanaṃ lehān sarpīṣi vividhāni ca//

payāṃsi śītāni rasāśca jāṅgalāḥ satīnayūṣāśca
                            saśāliṣaṣṭikāḥ/

hitaṃ ca śākaṃ ghṛtasaṃskṛtaṃ sadā tathaiva
                            dhātrīphaladāḍimānvitam/
himāḥ pradehā madhurā gaṇāśca ye ghṛtāni pathyāni ca raktapittinām//
hitaṃ ca kharjūraphalaṃ samākṣikaṃ phalāni cānyānyapi tadguṇānyatha//

palāśavṛkṣasvarase vipakvaṃ sarpiḥ pibet
                            kṣaudrayutaṃ suśītam/
vanaspatīnāṃ svarasaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā saśarkaraṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ pibedvā//
sthitaṃ niśāṃ tadrudhirāmayaṃ jayet pītaṃ payo vā+ambusamaṃ hitāśinaḥ//

turaṅgavarcaḥsvarasaṃ samākṣikaṃ pibet
                            sitākṣaudrayutaṃ vṛṣasya vā/
drākṣāṃ sitāṃ tiktakarohiṇīṃ ca himāmbunā vā madhukena yuktām//

pathyāmahiṃsrāṃ rajanīṃ ghṛtaṃ ca lihyāttathā
                            śoṇitapittarogī/

puṣpāṇi śigrośca vicūrṇya leho madhvanvitaḥ
                            śoṇitapittaroge/

jambvarjunāmrakvathitaṃ ca toyaṃ ghnanti trayaḥ
                            pittamasṛk ca yogāḥ/
mūlāni puṣpāṇi ca mātuluṅgyāḥ piṣṭvā pibettaṇḍuladhāvanena//

ghrāṇapravṛtte jalamāśu deyaṃ saśarkaraṃ
                            nāsikayā payo vā/
drākṣārasaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ pibedvā saśarkaraṃ cekṣurasaṃ himaṃ vā//

virekayoge tvati caiva śasyate vāmyaśca rakte
                            vijite balānvitaḥ//
pravṛttarakteṣu ca pāyujeṣu kuryādvidhānaṃ khalu raktapaittam//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre
                        raktapittapratiṣedho nāma (saptamo+adhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ)
                        pañcacatvāriṃśattamo+adhyāyaḥ //45//

hṛtpīḍā jṛmbhaṇaṃ glāniḥ saṃjñānāśo balasya
                            ca/
moho mūrccheti tāṃ prāhuḥ ṣaḍvidhā sā prakīrtitā//
vātādibhiḥ śoṇitena madyena ca viṣeṇa ca/
gātrāṇi vikṣipan bhūmau jarāṃ yāvanna yāti tat//

sekāvagāhau maṇayaḥ sahārāḥ śītāḥ pradehā
                            vyajanānilāśca/
śītāni pānāni ca gandhavanti sarvāsu mūrcchāsvanivāritāni//
kharjūrakāśmaryarasaiḥ śṛtāni pānāni sarpīṃṣi ca jīvanāni//

siddhāni varge madhure payāṃsi sadāḍimā
                            jāṅgalajā rasāśca/
tathā yavā lohitaśālayaśca mūrcchāsu pathyāśca sadā satīnāḥ//

bhujaṅgapuṣpaṃ maricānyuśīraṃ kolasya madhyaṃ
                            ca pibet samāni/

bisaṃ
                            mṛṇālaṃ kṣaudreṇa kṛṣṇāṃ sitayā ca pathyām//
mūrcchāṃ prasaktāṃ tu śirovirekairjayedabhīkṣṇaṃ vamanaiśca tīkṣṇaiḥ//

harītakīkvāthaśṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā dhātrīphalānāṃ svarasaiḥ
                            kṛtaṃ vā/

pibet kaṣāyāṇi ca gandhavanti pittajvaraṃ yāni
                            śamaṃ nayanti/
ābhiḥ kriyābhiśca na labdhasaṃjñaḥ sānāhalālāśvasanaśca varjyaḥ//

madyamuṣṇaṃ tathā tīkṣṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viśadameva
                            ca/
rūkṣamāśukaraṃ caiva vyavāyi ca vikāśi ca//
vidhivat sevyamāne tu madye sannihitā guṇāḥ//
madena karaṇānāṃ tu bhāvānyatve kṛte sati/

tryavasthaśca mado jñeyaḥ pūrvo madhyo+atha
                            paścimaḥ/

nirbhaktamekāntata eva madyaṃ niṣevyamāṇaṃ
                            manujena nityam/
uṣṇābhitaptena ca sevyamānaṃ karoti madyaṃ vividhān vikārān//

liṅgaṃ parasya tu madasya vadanti tajjñāstṛṣṇāṃ
                            rujāṃ śirasi sandhiṣu cāpi bhedam/

jñeyāni tatra bhiṣajā suviniścitāni
                            pittaprakopajanitāni ca kāraṇāni/

dveṣaḥ surānnavikṛteṣu ca teṣu teṣu taṃ
                            pānavibhramamuśantyakhilena dhīrāḥ/

jihvauṣṭhadantamasitaṃ tvathavā+api nīlaṃ pīte
                            ca yasya nayane rudhiraprame ca/

hikkājvarau vamathuvepathupārśvaśūlāḥ kāsabhramāvapi ca pānahataṃ
                            bhajante//

teṣāṃ nivāraṇamidaṃ hi mayocyamānaṃ
                            vyaktābhidhānamakhilena vidhiṃ nibodha/

pṛthvīkadīpyakamahauṣadhahiṅgubhirvā
                            sauvarcalena ca yutaṃ vitaret sukhāya/

pītvā ca madyamapi cekṣurasapragāḍhaṃ
                            niḥśeṣataḥ kṣaṇamavasthitamullikhecca/

lāvaiṇatittirirasāṃśca pibedanamlān maudgān sukhāya saghṛtān sasitāṃśca
                            yūṣān//
seveta tiktakaṭukāṃśca rasānudārān yūṣāṃśca tiktakaṭukopahitān hitāya//

pathyaṃ yavānnavikṛtāni ca jāṅgalāni
                            śleṣmaghnamanyadapi yacca niratyayaṃ syāt/

kuryācca sarvamatha sarvabhave vidhānaṃ ddvandvodbhave dvayamavekṣya
                            yathāpradhānam//

sāmānyamanyadapi yacca samagramagryaṃ vakṣyāmi
                            yacca manaso madakṛt sukhaṃ ca/

piṣṭaiḥ sapadmakayutairapi sārivādyaiḥ sekaṃ
                            jalaiśca vitaredamalaiḥ suśītaiḥ/

drākṣāyutaṃ hṛtamalaṃ madirāmayārtaistatpānakaṃ
                            śuci sugandhi narairniṣevyam/

piṣṭvā pibecca madhukaṃ kaṭurohiṇīṃ ca drākṣāṃ ca mūlamasakṛt
                            trapuṣībhavaṃ yat//

kārpāsinīmatha ca
                            nāgabalāṃ ca tulyāṃ pītvā sukhī bhavati sādhu suvarcalāṃ ca/

tadbījapūrakarasāyutamāśu pītaṃ śāntiṃ parāṃ
                            paramade tvacirāt karoti/

sauvarcalāyutamudārarasaṃ phalāmlaṃ
                            bhārgīśṛtena ca jalena hito+avasekaḥ//
vipācya tasyāñjalinā vameddhi madyaṃ pibeccāhni gate tvajīrṇe//

hṛdyaiḥ khaḍairapi ca bhojanamatra śastaṃ
                            drākṣākapitthaphaladāḍimapānakaṃ yat/

drākṣātrivṛtsu ca
                            kṛtaṃ sasitaṃ himaṃ vā/

pañcendriyārthaviṣayā mṛdupānayogā hṛdyāḥ
                            sukhāśca manasaḥ satataṃ niṣevyāḥ
drākṣāṃ ca kṛṣṇāmatha keśaraṃ ca kṣīre samāloḍya pibet

bhavecca madyena tu yena pātitaḥ prakāmapītena
                            surāsavādinā/

yathā narendropahatasya kasyacidbhavet
                            prasādastata eva nānyataḥ/
dhruvaṃ tathā madyahatasya dehino bhavet prasādastata eva nānyataḥ//

śītaṃ vidhānamata ūrdhvamahaṃ pravakṣye
                            dāhapraśāntikaramṛddhimatāṃ narāṇām/
bhinnotpalojjvalahime śayane śayīta patreṣu vā sajalabinduṣu padminīnām//

tatrainamamburuhapatrasamaiḥ spṛśantyaḥ śītaiḥ karoruvadanaiḥ kaṭhinaiḥ
                            stanaiśca//

tā enamārdravasanāḥ saha saṃviśeyuḥ
                            śliṣṭvā+avalāḥ śithilamekhalahārayaṣṭyaḥ//
sarva eva ca varjyāḥ syuḥ śītagātreṣu dehiṣu//
madyāni hṛdyānyatha gandhavanti pītāni sadyaḥ śamayanti tṛṣṇām//

iti suśrutasṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre
                        madātyayapratiṣedho nāma (navamo+adhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ)
                        saptacatvāriṃśattamo+adhyāyaḥ //47//
punaḥ kāṅkṣati toyaṃ ca taṃ tṛṣṇārditamādiśet//
dhātukṣayāllaṅghanasūryatāpāt pittaṃ ca vātaśca bhṛśaṃ pravṛddhau//

srotāṃsi saṃdūṣayataḥ sametau yānyambuvāhīni
                            śarīriṇāṃ hi/

tisraḥ smṛtāstāḥ kṣatajā caturthī
                            kṣayāttathā+anyā++āmasamudbhavā ca/
srotonirodho virasaṃ ca vaktraṃ śītabhiradbhiśca vivṛddhimeti//
śītābhikāṅkṣā mukhatiktatā ca pittātmikāyāṃ paridhūpanaṃ ca//
kaphātmikāyāṃ gurugātratā ca śākhāsu śophastvavipāka eva/
etāni rūpāṇi bhavanti tasyāṃ tayā+arditaḥ kāṅkṣati nāti cāmbhaḥ//
tayā+abhibhūtasya niśādināni gacchanti duḥkhaṃ pibato+api toyam//

rasakṣayādyā
                            kṣayajā matā sā tayā+arditaḥ śuṣyati dahyate ca/
atyarthamākāṅkṣati cāpi toyaṃ tāṃ sannipātāditi kecidāhuḥ//
jalaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ śamayettu tṛṣṇāṃ saśarkaraṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ himaṃ vā//

pittaghnavargaistu kṛtaḥ kaṣāyaḥ saśarkaraḥ
                            kṣaudrayutaḥ suśītaḥ/
pītastṛṣāṃ pittakṛtāṃ nihanti kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ vā+apyatha jīvanīyaiḥ//

vargasya siddhasya ca sārivādeḥ pātavyamambhaḥ
                            śiśiraṃ tṛṣārtaiḥ/
rājādanakṣīrikapītaneṣu ṣaṭ pānakānyatra hitāni ca syuḥ//

kṣayotthitāṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ nihanyānmāṃsodakaṃ vā
                            madhukodakaṃ vā/
gurvannajātāṃ vamanairjayecca kṣayādṛte sarvakṛtāṃ ca tṛṣṇām//

śramodbhavāṃ māṃsaraso nihanti guḍodakaṃ
                            vā+apyathavā+api manthaḥ/

yā snehapītasya bhavecca tṛṣṇā tatroṣṇamambhaḥ
                            prapibenmanuṣyaḥ/
madyodbhavāmardhajalaṃ nihanti madyaṃ tṛṣāṃ yā+api ca madyapasya//

tṛṣṇodbhavāṃ hanti
                            jalaṃ suśītaṃ saśarkaraṃ sekṣurasaṃ tathā+ambhaḥ/
svaiḥ svaiḥ kaṣāyairvamanāni tāsāṃ tathā jvaroktāni ca pācanāni//
saṃśodhanaṃ kṣīrarasau ghṛtāni sarvāsu lehānmadhurān himāṃśca//
pūrvarūpaṃ mataṃ chardyā yathāsvaṃ ca vibhāvayet//
śrāntaḥ saghoṣaṃ bahuśaḥ kaṣāyaṃ jīrṇe+adhikaṃ sā+anilajā vamistu//

yo+amlaṃ bhṛśaṃ vā kaṭutiktavaktraḥ pītaṃ
                            saraktaṃ haritaṃ vamedvā/

yo hṛṣṭaromā madhuraṃ prabhūtaṃ śuklaṃ himaṃ
                            sāndrakaphānuviddham/

sarvāṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti yasyāṃ sā
                            sarvadoṣaprabhavā matā tu/
sa ghoṣavānāśu hinastyasūn yatastatastu hikketi bhiṣagbhirucyate//

annajāṃ yamalāṃ kṣudrāṃ gambhīrāṃ mahatīṃ
                            tathā/
vāyuḥ kaphenānugataḥ pañca hikkāḥ karoti hi//

kṣudrikā nāma sā hikkā jatrumūlāt
                            pradhāvitā/

āyamyate hikkato+aṅgāni yasya dṛṣṭiścordhvaṃ
                            tāmyate yasya gāḍham/
kāsate yaśca hikkī tau dvāvantyau varjayeddhikkamānau//
yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vā mākṣikeṇāvapīḍe pippalyo vā śarkarācūrṇayuktāḥ//

sarpiḥ koṣṇaṃ kṣīramikṣo raso vā nātikṣīṇe
                            chardanaṃ
nārīpayaḥpiṣṭamaśuklacandanaṃ ghṛtaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ ca sasaindhavaṃ tathā//

cūrṇīkṛtaṃ saindhavamambhasā+athavā nihanti
                            hikkāṃ ca hitaṃ ca nasyataḥ/
yuñjyāddhūmaṃ śālaniryāsajātaṃ naipālaṃ vā goviṣāṇodbhavaṃ vā//

sarpiḥsnigdhaiścarmabālaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā hikkāsthāne
                            svedanaṃ cāpi kāryam/
kṣaudropetaṃ gairikaṃ kāñcanāhvaṃ lihyādbhasma grāmyasattvāsthijaṃ vā//

svarjikṣāraṃ bījapūrādrasena kṣaudropetaṃ hanti
                            līḍhvā++āśu hikkām/
sarpiḥsnigdhā ghnanti hikkāṃ yavāgvaḥ koṣṇagrāsāḥ pāyaso vā sukhoṣṇaḥ//

śuṇṭhītoye sādhitaṃ kṣīramājaṃ tadvat pītaṃ
                            śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ vā/
ātṛptervā sevyamānaṃ nihantyād ghrātaṃ hikkāmāśu mūtraṃ tvajāvyoḥ//

pibet palaṃ vā lavaṇottamasya dvābhyāṃ
                            palābhyāṃ haviṣaḥ samagram/

kṛṣṇāṃ sitāṃ cāmalakaṃ ca līḍhaṃ saśṛṅgaveraṃ
                            madhunā+athavā+api/

virecanaṃ pathyatamaṃ sasaindhavaṃ ghṛtaṃ
                            sukhoṣṇaṃ ca sitopalāyutam/
taireva kāraṇaiḥ śvāso ghoro bhavati dehinām//
bhidyate sa mahāvyādhiḥ śvāsa eko viśeṣataḥ//
ānāhaḥ pārśvayoḥ śūlaṃ vairasyaṃ vadanasya ca//
niṣaṇṇasyaiti śāntiṃ ca sa kṣudra iti saṃjñitaḥ//

sa śāmyati kaphe hīne svapataśca
                            vidhardhate/
saṃrabdhanetrastvāyamya yaḥ śvasyāt sa mahān smṛtaḥ/
trayaḥ śvāsā na sidhyanti tamako durbalasya ca//

śvāse kāse ca hikkāyāṃ hṛdroge cāpi
                            pūjitam/
suvahā kālikā bhargī śukākhyā naiculaṃ phalam//
vāsāghṛtaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ cātra hitaṃ bhavet//

hanyuḥ śvāsaṃ ca kāsaṃ ca saṃskṛtāni payāṃsi
                            ca/
haridrāṃ maricaṃ drākṣāṃ guḍaṃ rāsnāṃ kaṇāṃ śaṭīm//
ete sarve sasarpiṣkā dhūmāḥ kāryā vijānatā/

durbale caiva rūkṣe ca tarpaṇaṃ
                            hitamucyate/
lihannaraḥ śvāsanipīḍito hi śvāsaṃ jayatyeva balāttryaheṇa//
rogāstathaite khalu durnivārāḥ śvāsaśca kāsaśca vilambikā ca//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre
                        hikkāśvāsapratiṣedho nāma (tryodaśo+adhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ)
                        ekapañcāśattamo+adhyāyaḥ //51//
uktā ye hetavo nṝṇāṃ rogayoḥ śvāsahikkayoḥ/
nireti vaktrāt sahasā sadoṣaḥ kāsaḥ sa vidvadbhirudāhṛtastu//
pittena pītāni vamet kaṭūni kāset sa pāṇḍuḥ paridahyamānaḥ//
viśliṣṭavakṣāḥ sa naraḥ saraktaṃ ṣṭhīvatyabhīkṣṇaṃ kṣatajaṃ
śuṣyan viniṣṭhīvati durbalastu prakṣīṇamāṃso rudhiraṃ sapūyam//
bhavettu yo vai yāpyaṃ tamāhurbhiṣajastu kāsam//
uṣṇāmbunā hiṅguyutaṃ tu pītvā baddhāsyamapyāśu jahāti kāsam//

pathyāṃ sitāmāmalakāni lājāṃ samāgadhīṃ cāpi
                            vicūrṇya śuṇṭhīm/
sarpirmadhubhyāṃ vilihīta kāsī sasaindhavāṃ voṣṇajalena kṛṣṇām//
drākṣāṃ sitāṃ māgadhikāṃ ca tulyāṃ saśṛṅgaveraṃ madhukaṃ tugāṃ ca//
ubhe haridre suradāruśuṇṭhīṃ gāyatrisāraṃ ca pibet samāṃśam//

bastasya mūtreṇa sukhāmbunā vā dantīṃ dravantīṃ
                            ca satilvakākhyām
bhṛṣṭāni sarpīṃṣyatha bādarāṇi khādet palāśāni sasaindhavāni//
kṣaudreṇa lihyānmaricāni vā+api bhārgīvacāhiṅgukṛtā ca vartiḥ//

dhūme praśastā ghṛtasaṃprayuktā
                            veṇutvagelālavaṇaiḥ kṛtā vā/
pibecca sīdhuṃ maricānvitaṃ vā tenāśu kāsaṃ jayati prasahya//
ebhirniṣeveta kṛtāṃ ca peyāṃ tanvīṃ suśītāṃ madhunā vimiśrām//

yat plīhni sarpirvihitaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ tadvātakāsaṃ
                            jayati prasahya/
vidārigandhādikṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā rasena vā vāsakajena pakvam//
dhūmaṃ pibet snaihikamapramattaḥ pibet sukhoṣṇaṃ ghṛtameva cātra//

hitā yavāgvaśca raseṣu siddhāḥ payāṃsi lehāḥ
                            saghṛtāstathaiva/

uṣṇāśca lehāḥ kaṭukā nihanyuḥ kaphaṃ viśeṣeṇa
                            viśoṣaṇaṃ ca/
kaṭutrikaṃ cāpi vadanti pathyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṛmighnasvarase vipakvam//

nirguṇḍipatrasvarase ca pakvaṃ sarpiḥ
                            kaphotthaṃ vinihanti kāsam/

ghṛtaṃ pacedikṣurasāmbudugdhaiḥ kākolivarge ca
                            saśarkaraṃ tat/
prātaḥ pibet pittakṛte ca kāse ratiprasūte kṣataje ca kāse//
kṣaudreṇa kāse kṣataje kṣayotthe pibedghṛtaṃ cekṣurase vipakvam//

cūrṇaṃ pibedāmalakasya vā+api kṣīreṇa pakvaṃ
                            saghṛtaṃ hitāśī/

kāseṣu peyastriṣu kāsavadbhiḥ kṣīreṇa
                            sakṣaudraghṛtena vā+api/
guḍodakaṃ vā kvathitaṃ pibeddhi kṣaudreṇa śītaṃ maricopadaṃśam//
dattvā trivṛccūrṇapalāni cāṣṭāvaṣṭau ca tailasya pacedyathāvat//

śāmyanti cāyaṃ ciramantaragnerhatasya
                            puṃstvasya ca vṛddhihetuḥ/
strīṇāṃ ca vandhyāmayanāśanaḥ syāt kalyāṇako nāma guḍaḥ pratītaḥ//

nyasya yavāḍhakaṃ ca harītakīnāṃ ca śataṃ
                            gurūṇām/
droṇe jalasyāḍhakasaṃyute ca kvāthe kṛte pūtacaturthabhāge//

pacettulāṃ śuddhaguḍasya dattvā pṛthak ca
                            tailāt kuḍavaṃ ghṛtācca/
cūrṇaṃ ca tāvanmagadhodbhavāyā deyaṃ ca tasminmadhu siddhaśīte//

rasāyanāt karṣamato vilihyāddve cābhaye
                            nityamathāśu hanyāt/

pacedghṛtaṃ tattu niṣevyamāṇaṃ hanyāt kṣatotthaṃ kṣayajaṃ ca kāsam//
                            śatāvarīnāgabalāvipakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ vidheyaṃ ca hitāya kāsinām/

srotaḥsu te svaravaheṣu gatāḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ hanyuḥ svaraṃ bhavati cāpi hi
                            ṣaḍvidhaḥ saḥ//

vātena kṛṣṇanayanānanamūtravarcā bhinnaṃ
                            śanairvadati gadgadavat svaraṃ ca/

kṛcchrāt kaphena satataṃ kapharuddhakaṇṭho
                            mandaṃ śanairvadati cāpi divā viśeṣaḥ

dhūpyeta vāk kṣayakṛte kṣayamāpnuyācca vāgeṣa
                            cāpi(vāpi) hatavāk parivarjanīyaḥ/

kṣīṇasya vṛddhasya kṛśasya cāpi cirotthito yaśca
                            sahopajātaḥ/
medasvinaḥ sarvasamudbhavaśca svarāmayo yo na sa siddhimeti//

yaḥ śvāsakāsavidhirādita eva coktastaṃ
                            cāpyaśeṣamavatārayituṃ yateta/

vaiśeṣikaṃ ca vidhimūrdhvamato vadāmi taṃ vai svarāturahitaṃ nikhilaṃ
                            nibodha//
lihyādvā madhutailābhyāṃ bhuktvā khādet kaṭūni vā//
dhamanyāṃ raktajānāṃ ca prasavaḥ prāyaśaḥ smṛtaḥ//
jvaro vivarṇatā śūlaṃ hṛdrogaḥ sadanaṃ bhramaḥ//

pratyāgate nirūhe tu naraṃ snātaṃ
                            sukhāmbunā/

khādet pūpalikāḥ pakvā dhānyāmlaṃ ca
                            pibedanu/
niṣkvāthena viḍaṅgānāṃ cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ tu tat//

kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni ghṛtāni caiva dadhīni śākāni ca
                            parṇavanti/
na vegān dhārayet prājño vātādīnāṃ jijīviṣuḥ//

kuryādapāno+abhihataḥ svamārge hanyāt purīṣaṃ
                            mukhataḥ kṣipedvā/
āṭopaśūlau parikartanaṃ ca saṅgaḥ purīṣasya tathordhvavātaḥ//
mūtrasya vege+abhihate narastu kṛcchreṇa mūtraṃ kurute+alpamalpam//

ānaddhabastiśca
                            bhavanti tīvrāḥ śūlāśca śūlairiva bhinnamūrteḥ//

ānandajaṃ śokasamudbhavaṃ vā netrodakaṃ
                            prāptamamuñcato hi/
śirogurutvaṃ nayanāmayāśca bhavanti tīvrāḥ saha pīnasena//
chardervighātena bhavecca kuṣṭhaṃ yenaiva doṣeṇa vidagdhamannam//
śukrāśmarī tatsravaṇaṃ bhavedvā te te vikārā vihate tu śukre//

sāmānyataḥ pṛthaktvena kriyāṃ bhūyo nibodha
                            me/

elāṃ vā+apyatha madyena kṣīraṃ vā+api
                            pibennaraḥ/
māṃsopadaṃśaṃ madhu vā pibedvā sīdhu gauḍikam//

bhadradāru ghanaṃ mūrvā haridrā madhukaṃ
                            tathā/
yacca yatra bhavetprāptaṃ tacca tasmin prayojayet//
bhojanaiḥ kupitaḥ sadya udāvartaṃ karoti hi//

ārevataphalaṃ cāpsu paktvā tena ghṛtaṃ
                            pacet/
gavāṃ mūtreṇa tā vartīḥ kārayettu gudānugāḥ/

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre
                        udāvartapratiṣedho nāma (saptadaśo+ādhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ)
                        pañcapañcāśattamo+adhyāyaḥ //55//
vaivarṇyakampau hṛdaye rujaśca bhavanti tasyāṃ śirasaśca bhedaḥ//

duṣṭaṃ tu bhuktaṃ kaphamārutābhyāṃ pravartate
                            nordhvamadhaśca yasya/

sādhyāsu pārṣṇyordahanaṃ praśastamagnipratāpo
                            vamanaṃ ca tīkṣṇam/
pakve tato+anne tu vilaṅghanaṃ syāt saṃpācanaṃ cāpi virecanaṃ ca//

viśuddhadehasya hi sadya eva
                            mūrcchātisārādirupaiti śāntim/
āsthāpanaṃ cāpi vadanti pathyaṃ sarvāsu yogānaparānnibodha//
sukhāmbupītaṃ vinihantyajīrṇaṃ śūlaṃ visūcīmaruciṃ ca sadyaḥ//

kṣārāgadaṃ vā lavaṇaṃ viṣaṃ vā
                            guḍapragāḍhānatha sarṣapān vā/
amlena vā saindhavahiṅguyuktau sabījapūrṇau saghṛtau trivargau//

kaṭutrikaṃ vā lavaṇairupetaṃ pibet
                            snuhīkṣīravimiśritaṃ tu/
dantīyuta vā magadhodbhavānāṃ kalkaṃ pibet koṣavatīrasena//
vyoṣaṃ karañjasya phalaṃ haridre mūlaṃ samaṃ cāpyatha mātuluṅgyāḥ//
suvāmitaṃ sādhuvirecitaṃ vā sulaṅghataṃ vā manujaṃ viditvā//
āmaṃ śakṛdvā nicitaṃ krameṇa bhūyo vibaddhaṃ viguṇānilena//

āmāśaye śūlamatho gurutvaṃ hṛllāsa
                            udgāravighātanaṃ ca/

athetaraṃ yo na śakṛdvamettamāmaṃ jayet
                            svedanapācanaiśca/
svinnasya pāyau viniveśya tāśca cūrṇāni caiṣāṃ pradhamettu nāḍyā//

mūtreṣu saṃsādhya yathāvidhānaṃ dravyāṇi
                            yānyūrdhvamadhaśca yānti/
eṣveva tailena ca sādhitena prāptaṃ yadi syādanuvāsayecca//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre kāyacikitsātantre visūcikāpratiṣedho
                        nāma (aṣṭādaśo+adhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ṣaṭpañcāśattamo+adhyāyaḥ //56//

doṣaiḥ pṛthak saha ca cittaviparyayācca
                            bhaktāyaneṣu hṛdi cāvatate pragāḍham/

nānne rucirbhavati taṃ bhiṣajo vikāraṃ bhaktopaghātamiha pañcavidhaṃ
                            vadanti///

hṛcchūlapīḍanayutaṃ virasānanatvaṃ vātātmake
                            bhavati liṅgamarocake tu/

hṛddāhacoṣabahutā mukhatiktatā ca mūrcchā satṛḍ bhavati pittakṛte
                            tathaiva//
sarvātmake pavanapittakaphā bahūni rūpāṇyathāsya hṛdaye samudīrayanti//

vāte vacāmbuvamanaṃ kṛtavān pibecca snehaiḥ surābhirathavoṣṇajalena
                            cūrṇam//

nimbāmbuvāmitavataḥ kaphaje+anupānaṃ
                            rājadrumāmbu madhunā tu sadīpyakaṃ syāt/

bījaiḥ karañjanṛpavṛkṣabhavaiśca piṣṭairlehaṃ pacet surabhimūtrayutaṃ
                            yathāvat//

mustāṃ vacāṃ trikaṭukaṃ rajanīdvayaṃ ca bhārgīṃ
                            ca kuṣṭhamatha nirdahanīṃ ca piṣṭvā/

mūtre+avije dviradamūtrayute pacedvā pāṭhāṃ tugāmativiṣāṃ rajanīṃ ca
                            mukhyām//

maṇḍūkimarkamamṛtāṃ ca salāṅgalākhyāṃ mūtre
                            pacettu mahiṣasya vidhānavidvā/
etānna santi caturo lihatastu lehān gulmāruciśvasanakaṇṭhahṛdāmayāśca//

adyādrasāṃśca vividhān vividhaiḥ prakārairbhuñjīta cāpi
                            laghurūkṣamanaḥsukhāni//

āsthāpanaṃ vidhivadatra virecanaṃ ca
                            kuryānmṛdūni śirasaśca virecanāni/

syādeṣa eva kaphavātahate vidhiśca śāntiṃ gate hutabhuji praśamāya
                            tasya//

icchābhighātabhayaśokahate+antaragnau bhāvān
                            bhavāya vitaret khalu śakyarūpān/

dainyaṃ gate manasi bodhanamatra śastaṃ yadyat
                            priyaṃ tadupasevyamarocake tu//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate
                        kāyacikitsātantre+arocakapratiṣedho nāma (ekonaviṃśo+adhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ)
                        saptapañcāśattamo+adhyāyaḥ//57//
mūtraukasādau dvau cāpi rogā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ//
vātakuṇḍalikāṃ taṃ tu vyādhiṃ vidyāt sudāruṇam//
vedanā ca parā bastau vātāṣṭhīleti tāṃ viduḥ//

vegaṃ sandhārya mūtrasya yo bhūyaḥ
                            sraṣṭumicchati/

bastau vā+apyathavā nāle maṇau vā yasya
                            dehinaḥ/

abhyantare bastimukhe vṛtto+alpaḥ sthira eva
                            ca/
bastiṃ meḍhraṃ gudaṃ caiva pradahan srāvayedadhaḥ//

viśadaṃ pītakaṃ mūtraṃ sadāhaṃ bahalaṃ
                            tathā/

tālasya taruṇaṃ mūlaṃ trapusasya rasaṃ
                            tathā/
śvetaṃ karkaṭakaṃ caiva prātastu payasā pibet//

śṛtaṃ vā madhuraiḥ kṣīraṃ sarpirmiśraṃ
                            pibennaraḥ/
kṣīre pariśṛtān tatra pibet sarpiḥ samāyutān//

pibedguḍena miśraṃ vā lihyāllehān pṛthak
                            pṛthak/
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi mūtradoṣe kramaṃ hitam//
vidhānaṃ tasya pūrvaṃ hi vyāsataḥ parikīrtitam//

kṣaudrārdhapātraṃ dattvā ca pātraṃ tu
                            kṣīrasarpiṣaḥ/
śarkarāyāśca cūrṇaṃ ca drākṣācūrṇaṃ ca tatsamam//
tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ cūrṇaṃ līḍhvā kṣīraṃ tataḥ pibet//

etat sarpiḥ prayuñjānaḥ śuddhadeho naraḥ
                            sadā/
tat siddhaṃ kalaśe sthāpyaṃ kṣaudraprasthena saṃyutam//
tasya khādedyathāśakti mātrāṃ kṣīraṃ tataḥ pibet//

prakṣāhitaṃ ca
                            dhanyaṃ ca sarvarogāpahaṃ śivam/

ādhmānaṃ ca saśūlaṃ ca mūtrasaṅgaṃ karoti
                            hi/
śarkarāyā viśeṣaṃ tu śṛṇu kīrtayato mama//

aśmarīṃ ca samāśritya yaduktaṃ prasamīkṣya
                            tat/
tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā tat peyaṃ tena vā+apyanuvāsanam//

pītaṃ ghṛtaṃ pittakṛcchraṃ nāśayet kṣīrameva
                            vā/

ye tvanye tu tathā kṛcchre tayoḥ proktaḥ
                            kriyāvidhiḥ//

iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre
                        mūtrakṛcchrapratiṣedho nāma (ekaviṃśatitamo+adhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ)
                        ekonaṣaṣṭitamo+adhyāyaḥ //59//

aśuciṃ bhinnamaryādaṃ kṣataṃ vā yadi
                            vā+akṣatam/

devāstathā śatrugaṇāśca teṣāṃ gandharvayakṣāḥ
                            pitaro bhujaṅgāḥ/
rakṣāṃsi yā cāpi piśācajātireṣo+aṣṭako devagaṇo grahākhyaḥ//
tejasvī sthiranayano varapradātā brahmaṇyo bhavati naraḥ sa devajuṣṭaḥ//
santuṣṭo bhavati na cānnapānajātairduṣṭātmā bhavati ca devaśatrujuṣṭaḥ//
nṛtyan vai prahasati cāru cālpaśabdaṃ gandharvagrahaparipīḍito manuṣyaḥ//
tejasvī vadati ca kiṃ dadāmi kasmai yo yakṣagrahaparipīḍito manuṣyaḥ//

pretebhyo visṛjati saṃstareṣu piṇḍān śāntātmā
                            jalamapi cāpasavyavastraḥ/

bhūmau yaḥ prasarati sarpavat kadācit sṛkkiṇyau
                                vilikhati
krodhālurvipulabalo niśāvihārī śaucadviḍ bhavati ca rakṣasā gṛhītaḥ//

sthūlākṣastvaritagatiḥ svaphenalehī nidrāluḥ
                            patati ca kampate ca yo+ati/
yaścādridviradanagādivicyutaḥ san saṃsṛṣṭo na bhavati vārdhakena juṣṭaḥ//

darpaṇādīn yathā chāyā śītoṣṇaṃ prāṇino
                            yathā/
svamaṇiṃ bhāskarasyosrā yathā dehaṃ ca dehadhṛk/

tapāṃsi tīvrāṇi tathaiva dānaṃ vratāni dharmo
                            niyamāśca satyam/
guṇāstathā+aṣṭāvapi teṣu nityā vyastāḥ samastāśca yathāprabhāvam//

na te manuṣyaiḥ saha saṃviśanti na vā manuṣyān
                            kvacidāviśanti/

yāni yeṣāṃ yatheṣṭāni tāni tebhyaḥ
                            pradāpayet/
hiṃsanti manujān yeṣu prāyaśo divaseṣu tu//

hiṅguṃ mūtraṃ ca bastasya dhūmamasya
                            prayojayet/
etena śāmyati kṣipraṃ balavānapi yo grahaḥ//
saindhavaṃ kaṭukāṃ hiṅguṃ vayaḥsthāṃ ca vacāmapi/

ye ye grahā na sidhyanti sarveṣāṃ
                            nayanāñjanam/
golomī cājalomī ca bhūtakeśī jaṭā tathā/

naipālī haritālaṃ ca rakṣoghnā ye ca
                            kīrtitāḥ/

asmin varge bhiṣak kuryāttailāni ca ghṛtāni
                            ca/
tataḥ prāpsyati siddhiṃ ca yaśaśca vipulaṃ bhiṣak//

hṛtkampaḥ śūnyatā svedo dhyānaṃ mūrcchā
                            pramūḍhatā/
dantān khādan vaman phenaṃ vivṛtākṣaḥ patet kṣitau//

alpakālānataraṃ cāpi punaḥ saṃjñāṃ labheta
                            saḥ/
so+apasmāra iti proktaḥ sa ca dṛṣṭaścaturvidhaḥ//
vepamāno daśan dantān śvasan phenaṃ vamannapi//

tato me cittanāśaḥ syāt sa pittabhava
                            ucyate/
tato me cittanāśaḥ syāt so+apasmāraḥ kaphātmakaḥ//
pralāpaḥ kūjanaṃ kleśaḥ pratyekaṃ tu bhavediha//
deve varṣatyapi yathā bhūmau bījāni kānicit//

tasya kāryo vidhiḥ sarvo ya unmādeṣu
                            vakṣyate/
tataḥ sidhyanti te sarve yogairanyaiśca sādhayet/

pitteṣu siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca pānābhyaṅgeṣu
                            pūjitam/

pūjāṃ rudrasya kurvīta tadgaṇānāṃ ca
                            nityaśaḥ/

jaṭilāṃ pañcamūlyau dve pathyāṃ cotkvāthya
                            yatnataḥ/
śuddhe kumbhe nidadhyācca saṃbhāraṃ taṃ surāṃ tataḥ//
sirāṃ vidhyedatha prāptāṃ maṅgalyāni ca dhārayet//

iti susrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate
                        bhūtavidyātantre+apasmārapratiṣedho nāma (dvitīyo+adhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ)
                        ekaṣaṣṭitamo+adhyāyaḥ //61//
mānasena ca duḥkhena sa pañcavidha ucyate//
āsphoṭayasyaṭati gāyati nṛtyaśīlo vikrośati bhramati cāpyanilaprakopāt//

tīkṣṇo himāmbuni caye+api sa vahniśaṅkī pittāddivā nabhasi paśyati
                            tārakāśca//

nidrāparo+alpakathano+alpabhuguṣṇasevī rātrau bhṛśaṃ bhavati cāpi
                            kaphaprakopāt//

sarvātmake pavanapittakaphā yathāsvaṃ
                            saṃharṣitā iva ca liṅgamudīrayanti//

gāḍhaṃ kṣate manasi ca priyayā riraṃsorjāyeta cotkaṭataro manaso
                            vikāraḥ//

citraṃ sa jalpati manonugataṃ visaṃjño
                            gāyatyatho hasati roditi
sarṣapānāṃ ca tailena nasyābhyaṅgau hitau sadā//
hṛdyaṃ yaddīpanīyaṃ ca tatpathyaṃ tasya bhojayet(yojayet)//
khyātaṃ phalaghṛtaṃ strīṇāṃ vandhyānāṃ cāśu garbhadam//)

brahmīmaindrīṃ viḍaṅgāni vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu surāṃ
                            jaṭhām/
viṣaghnīṃ laśunaṃ rāsnāṃ viśalyāṃ surasāṃ vacām//
viṣaje mṛdupūrvāṃ ca viṣaghnīṃ kārayet kriyām//

doṣāṇāṃ tatra
                            matimān triṣaṣṭiṃ tu prayojayet//
tiktaḥ kaṣāyamanveti te dvikā daśa pañca ca//

tadyathā madhurāmlaḥ, madhuralavaṇaḥ,
                            madhurakaṭukaḥ, madhuratiktaḥ, madhurakaṣāyaḥ, ete pañcānukrāntā
                            madhureṇa; amlalavaṇaḥ, amlakaṭukaḥ, amlatiktaḥ, amlakaṣāyaḥ, ete
                            catvāro+anukrāntā amlena; lavaṇakaṭukaḥ, lavaṇatiktaḥ, lavaṇakaṣāyaḥ,
                            ete trayo+anukāntā lavaṇena; kaṭutiktaḥ, kaṭukaṣāyaḥ, dvāvetāvanukrāntau
                            kaṭukena; tiktakaṣāyaḥ eka evānukrāntastiktena;

trikān vakṣyāmaḥ ādau prayujyamānastu madhuro
                            daśa gacchati/

tadyathā madhurāmlalavaṇaḥ, madhurāmlakaṭukaḥ,
                            madhurāmlatiktaḥ, madhurāmalakaṣāyaḥ, madhuralavaṇakaṭukaḥ,
                            madhuralavaṇātiktaḥ, madhuralavaṇakaṣāyaḥ, madhurakaṭukatiktaḥ,
                            madhurakaṭukaṣāyaḥ, madhuratiktakaṣāyaḥ, evameṣāṃ daśānāṃ
                            trikasaṃyogānāmādau madhuraḥ prayujyate; amlalavaṇakaṭukaḥ,
                            amlalavaṇatiktaḥ, amlalavaṇakaṣāyaḥ, amlakaṭutiktaḥ, amlakaṭukaṣāyaḥ,
                            amlatiktakaṣāyaḥ, evameṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāmādāvamlaḥ prayujyate; lavaṇakaṭutiktaḥ,
                            lavaṇakaṭukaṣāyaḥ, lavaṇatiktakaṣāyaḥ, evameṣāṃ trayāṇāmādau lavaṇaḥ
                            prayujyate; kaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ, evamekasyādau kaṭukaḥ prayujyate; evamete
                            trikasaṃyogā viṃśatirvyākhyātāḥ//

madhurāmlalavaṇakaṭukaḥ,
                            madhurāmlalavaṇatiktaḥ, madhurāmlalavaṇakaṣāyaḥ, madhurāmlakaṭukatiktaḥ,
                            madhurāmlakaṭukaṣāyaḥ, madhurāmlatiktakaṣāyaḥ,
                            madhuralavaṇakaṭukatiktaḥ, madhuralavaṇakaṭukaṣāyaḥ,
                            madhuralavaṇatiktakaṣāyaḥ, madhurakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ, evameṣāṃ daśānāmādau
                            madhuraḥ prayujyate; amlalavaṇakaṭutiktaḥ, amlalavaṇakaṭukaṣāyaḥ,
                            amlalavaṇatiktakaṣāyaḥ, amlakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ, evameṣāṃ
                            caturṇāmādāvamlaḥ; lavaṇakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ, evamekasyādau lavaṇaḥ;
                            evamete catuṣkarasasaṃyogāḥ pañcadaśa kīrtitāḥ//

madhurāmlalavaṇakaṭutiktaḥ,
                            madhurāmlalavaṇakaṭukaṣāyaḥ, madhurāmlalavaṇatiktakaṣāyaḥ,
                            madhurāmlakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ, madhuralavaṇakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ, evameṣāṃ
                            pañcānāmādau madhuraḥ prayujyate; amlalavaṇakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ,
                            evamekasyādāvamlaḥ; evamete ṣaṭ pañcakasaṃyogā vyākhyātāḥ//

ṣaṭkamekaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ; ekastu ṣaṭkasaṃyogaḥ
                            madhurāmlalavaṇakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ; eṣa eka eva ṣaṭsaṃyogaḥ//

ekaikaśca ṣaṭsā bhavanti madhuraḥ, amlaḥ,
                            lavaṇaḥ, kaṭukaḥ, tiktaḥ, kaṣāyaḥ, iti//

tasya yadvṛttamuktaṃ hi rakṣaṇaṃ ca
                            mayā++āditaḥ/

yasmin yasminnṛtau ye ye doṣāḥ kupyanti
                            dehinām/
teṣu teṣu pradātavyāḥ rasāste te vijānatā//
śīte sāgnau nivāte ca guruprāvaraṇe gṛhe/

salilaṃ ca prasannatvāt sarvameva tadā
                            hitam/

rātrau jāgagṇaṃ caiva maithunaṃ cāpi
                            varjayet/
bhajecca śāradaṃ mālyaṃ sīdhoḥ pānaṃ ca yuktitaḥ//

prakāmaṃ ca niṣeveta maithunaṃ tarpito
                            nṛpaḥ/
annapānaṃ tilān māṣāñchākāni ca dadhīni ca/

madyāni ca prasannāni yacca kiñcit
                            balapradam/
) eṣa eva vidhiḥ kāryaḥ śiśire samudāhṛtaḥ//
auṣṇyādvasante kupitaḥ kurute ca gadān bahūn//
utsādanaṃ tathā snānaṃ vanitāḥ kānanāni ca//
bhojanaṃ ca hitaṃ śītaṃ saghṛtaṃ madhuradravam//
tāpātyaye hitā nityaṃ rasā ye guravastrayaḥ//

payo māṃsarasāḥ koṣṇāstailāni ca ghṛtāni
                            ca/
vyāyāmaṃ ca divāsvapnaṃ vyavāyaṃ cātra varjayet//

pibet prāvṛṣi jīrṇāṃstu rātrau tānapi
                            varjayet/
ṛtāvṛtau ya etena vidhinā vartate naraḥ//
ataḥ paraṃ tu svasthānāṃ vṛttyarthaṃ sarva eva ca/

tatrābhaktaṃ
                            prāgbhaktamadhobhaktaṃ madhyebhaktamantarābhaktaṃ sabhaktaṃ sāmudgaṃ
                            muhurmuhurgrāsaṃ grāsāntaraṃ ceti daśauṣadhakālāḥ//

tadbālavṛddhavanitāmṛdavastu pītvā glāniṃ parāṃ
                            samupayānti balakṣayaṃ ca//

śīghraṃ vipākamupayāti balaṃ na
                            hiṃsyādannāvṛtaṃ na ca muhurvardanānnireti/

pītaṃ yadannamupayujya tadūrdhvakāye
                            hanyādgadān bahuvidhāṃśca balaṃ dadāti/

madhye tu pītamapahantyavisāribhāvādye madhyadehamabhibhūya bhavanti
                            rogāḥ//

pathyaṃ sabhaktamabalābalayorhi nityaṃ
                            taddveṣiṇāmapi tathā śiśuvṛddhayośca/

hṛdyaṃ manobalakaraṃ tvatha dīpanaṃ ca pathyaṃ sadā bhavati
                            cāntarabhaktakaṃ yat//

doṣe dvidhā pravisṛte tu
                            samudgasaṃjñamādyantayoryadaśanasya niṣevyate tu//

śvāse muhurmuhuratiprasṛte ca kāse hikkāvamīṣu
                            sa vadantyupayojyametat//

cūrṇamabalāgniṣu dīpanīyaṃ vājīkarāṇyapi tu
                            yojayituṃ yateta/

visṛṣṭe viṇmūtre viśadakaraṇe dehe ca
                            sulaghau/
viśuddhe codgāre hṛdi suvimale vāte ca sarati/
pradeyastvāhāro bhavati bhiṣajāṃ kālaḥ sa tu mataḥ//

tadyathā adhikaraṇaṃ, yogaḥ, padārthaḥ, hetvarthaḥ, uddeśaḥ, nirdeśaḥ,
                            upadeśaḥ, apadeśaḥ, pradeśaḥ, atideśaḥ, apavarjaḥ, vākyaśeṣaḥ,
                            arthāpattiḥ, viparyayaḥ, prasaṅgaḥ, ekāntaḥ, anekāntaḥ, pūrvapakṣaḥ,
                            nirṇayaḥ, anumataṃ, vidhānam, anāgatāvekṣaṇam, atikrāntāvekṣaṇaṃ,
                            saṃśayaḥ, vyākhyānaṃ, svasaṃjñā, nirvacanaṃ, nidarśanaṃ, niyogaḥ,
                            vikalpaḥ, samuccayaḥ, ūhyam, iti//

atrāsāṃ tantrayuktīnāṃ kiṃ prayojanam ucyate
                            vākyayojanamarthayojanaṃ ca//

bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ asadvādiprayuktānāṃ
                            vākyānāṃ pratiṣedhanam/

vyāktā noktāstu ye
                            hyarthā līnā ye cāpyanirmalāḥ/

tatra yamarthamadhikṛtyocyate tadadhikaraṇaṃ;
                            yathā rasaṃ doṣaṃ vā//
siddhaṃ balābhyāṃ ca sadevadāru hitāya nityaṃ galagaṇḍaroge/

ityatra tailaṃ siddhaṃ pibediti prathamaṃ vaktavye tṛtīyapāde siddhamiti
                            prayuktaṃ, evaṃ dūrasthānāmapi padānāmekīkaraṇaṃ yogaḥ//

vā sa padārthaḥ;
                            padasya padayoḥ padānāṃ vā+arthaḥ padārthaḥ; aparimitāśca padārthāḥ/

yathā snehasvedāñjaneṣu nirdiṣṭeṣu dvayostrayāṇāṃ
                            vā+arthānāmupapattirdṛśyate, tatra yo+arthaḥ pūrvāparayogasiddho bhavati
                            sa grahītavyaḥ; yathā devotpattimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma ityukte
                            sandihyate buddhiḥ katamasya

vedasyotpattiṃ vakṣyatīti, yataḥ ṛgvedādayastu vedāḥ;
                            vida vicāraṇe, vidḷ lābhe, ityetayośca dhātvoranekārthayoḥ
                            prayogāt,tatra pūrvāparayogamupalabhya pratipattirbhavati
                            āyurvedotpattimayaṃ vivakṣuriti; eṣa padārthaḥ//

yathā mṛtpiṇḍo+adbhiḥ praklidyate tathā māṣadugdhaprabhṛtibhirvraṇaḥ
                            praklidyata iti//
yathā tathā na jāgṛyādrātrau divāsvapnaṃ ca varjayet iti//

yena padenānuktena vākyaṃ samāpyeta sa
                            vākyaśeṣaḥ/

yathā śiraḥpāṇipādapārśvapṛṣṭhodarorasāmityukte puruṣagrahaṇaṃ vinā+api
                            gamyate puruṣasyeti//

yathā odanaṃ bhokṣye ityukte+arthādāpannaṃ bhavati nāyaṃ
                            pipāsuryavāgūmiti//

yathā kṛśālpaprāṇabhīravo duścikitsyā ityukte viparītaṃ gṛhyate
                            dṛḍhādayaḥ sucikitsyā iti//

yathā pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ puruṣastasmin kriyā so+adhiṣṭhānamiti
                            vedotpattāvabhidhāya, bhūtacintāyāṃ punaruktaṃ yato+abhihitaṃ
                            pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ puruṣa iti, sa khalveṣa
                            karmapuruṣaścikitsādhikṛta iti//

yathā kecidācāryā bruvate dravyaṃ pradhānaṃ, kecidrasaṃ, kecidvīryaṃ
                            kecidvipākamiti//
yathā kathaṃ vātanimittāścatvāraḥ pramehā asādhyā bhavantīti//

yathā śarīraṃ prapīḍya paścādadho gatvā vasāmedomajjānuviddhaṃ mūtraṃ
                            visṛjati vātaḥ, evamasādhyā vātajā iti//

tathā coktam kṛtsnaṃ śarīraṃ niṣpīḍya
                            medomajjāvasāyutaḥ/

yathā anyo brūyāt sapta rasā iti, taccāpratiṣedhādanumanyate
                            kathaṃciditi//

yathā iha pañcaviṃśatikaḥ puruṣo vyākhyāyate, anyeṣvāyurvedatantreṣu
                            bhūtādiprabhṛtyārabhya

kakṣe vṛddhiṃ gacchati tathā vātapittakaphaduṣṭo
                            vraṇa iti//

caturvidhaścāhāraḥ praviralaḥ, prāyeṇa dvividha eva; ato
                            dvitvaṃ prasiddhamiti/

kiñcānyat annena bhakṣyamavaruddhaṃ, ghanasādharmyāt; peyena lehyaṃ,
                                dravasādhamyāt

kati tatraikaśo jñeyā dviśo vā+apyathavā
                            triśaḥ/
trayo doṣā dhātavaśca purīṣaṃ mūtrameva ca//

rogāṇāṃ tu sahasraṃ yacchataṃ viṃśatireva
                            ca/

vyāsataḥ kīrtitaṃ taddhi bhinnā doṣāstrayo
                            guṇāḥ/

traya eva pṛthak doṣā dviśo nava
                            samādhikaiḥ/

bhiṣak kartā+atha karaṇaṃ rasā doṣāstu
                            kāraṇam/

sahottaraṃ tvetadadhītya sarvaṃ brāhmaṃ
                            vidhānena yathoditena/
